nyi shu drug pa/ dge slong ma dang lhan cig 'gron lam du 'jug pa'i lhung byed/ 228nyi shu bdun pa/ dge slong ma dang lhan cig grur 'jug pa'i nyung byed/ 236nyi shu brgyad pa/ gcig pu 'dug pa'i snang byed/ 24nanyi shu dgu pa/ gcig pu 'greng ba'i nyung byed/ 248sum bcu pa/ dge slong mas sbyor du bcug pa za ba'i snang byed/ 252bcu tshan bzhi pa/ yang yang za ba la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 271sum bcu rtsa gcig pa/ yang yang za ba'i snang byed/ 271sum bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'dug gnas gcig tu za ba'i lhung byed/ 304sum bcu rtsa gsum pa/ lhung bzed do gsum tsam las lhag par len pa'i cing byed/ 25sum bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ stan gcig pa'i zas kyi snang byed/ 336sum bcu rtsa lnga pa/ spangs pa la stobs pa'i nyung byed/ da49sum bcu rtsa drug pa/ 'dus shing za ba'i nyung byed/ 255sum bcu rtsa bdun pa/ dus ma yin par za ba'i snang byed/ 361sum bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ gsog 'jog gi snang byed/ 865sum bcu rtsa dgu pa/ byin len ma byas par za ba'i snang byed/ 370bzhi bcu pa/ bsod pa slong ba'i lhung byed/ 386bcu tshan lnga pa/ chu la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 94bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ srog chags dang bcas pa'i chu la spyod pa'i nyung byed/ 394bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ nyal po byed par shom pa'i khyim na 'dug pa'i snang byed/ 97bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ nyal po byed par shom pa'i khyim na 'greng ba'i cing byed/ 400bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ gcer bu pa la sbyin pa'i snang byed/ 40dbazhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ dmag la lta ba'i cing byed/ 419bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa/ dmag gi dang na gnas pa'i snang byed/ 425bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa/ dpung gi yan lag nyams su myong bar byed pa'i nyung byed/ 431bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ deg pa'i sang byed/ 429bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa/ gzas pa'i snang byed/ 442lnga bcu pa/ gnas ngan len 'chab pa'i nyung byed/ 446bcu tshan drug pa/ khyim la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 4502

lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ zan gcod du 'jud pa'i snang byed/ 450lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ me la reg pa'i snang byed/ 456lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/ 'dun pa phyir sgyur ba'i nyung byed/ 485lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ rdzogs par ma bsnyen pa dang lhan cig nyal ba'i snang byed/ 489lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa/ lta ba'i rnam pa mi gtong ba'i snang byed/ 502lnga bcu rtsa drug pa/ spangs pa'i rjes su phyogs pa'i cing byed/ 514lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa/ bsnyil ba sdud pa'i lhung byed/ 518lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ kha ma bsgyur ba'i gos gyon pa'i snang byed/ 534lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa/ longs pa'i gzhir gtogs pa'i snang byed/ 558drug bcu pa/ khrus byed pa'i snang byed/ 587bcu tshan bdun pa/ bsams bzhin la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 599drug bcu rtsa gcig pa/ dud 'gro gsod pa'i snang byed/ 599drug bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'gyod pa skyed pa'i snang byed/ 606drug bcu rtsa gsum pa/ ga ga tshil byed pa'i snang byed/ 614drug bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ chu la rtse ba'i lhung byed/ 618drug bcu rtsa lnga pa/ bud med dang lhan cig nyal ba'i snang byed/ 624drug bcu rtsa drug pa/ sngangs par byed pa'i lhung byed/ 650drug bcu rtsa bdun pa/ sped pa'i snang byed/ 657drug bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ byin pas nye bar 'tsho ba'i lhung byed/ 662drug bcu rtsa dgu pa/ skur pa 'debs pa'i cing byed/ 667bdun bcu pa/ bud med dang lhan cig 'gro ba'i cing byed/ 674bcu tshan bdun pa/ 'gron mang rkun ma sogs kyi sde tshan/ 680bdun bcu rtsa gcig pa/ rkun ma dang lhan cig 'gro ba'i snang byed/ 680bdun bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ lo nyi shu ma lon par rdzogs par bsnyen par byed pa'i snang byed/ 684bsdur mchan/(693) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(833〉

ci ci 'a ru ba rasna ca rtsi tshan tsā 7ri ri ci riḥ ge pa sne ༷༷ nga /da spro rdzo ji ba sta getsho 7/ ci snang la sgo tsha nga 〉cad ne zhe ñdza ge ri ci/ci cig cisnye —— — — sdu cis hro likhri la ཿ dzha ṣe rdoci byu tsho ci ca ༷ snam tsho ḍa ci ci ru ri ci — cing — — — rtsaX tsho ye — ba ci (ci tsho ༷ ri ri kyi ri ci spyo ded ge rtse bye sna — —parsharsha ci sa rto pa rdzong sto ci la snisgong ci sna ci ṇa ci ci smo —— 4tsha sna ༄/ /byang phyogs dri 'dzin yul 'khrungs pa'i/ /nyon mongs dgra bcom kāshya pa/ /

༄༅/ /'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bzhi bcu rtsa ②gsum pa / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor dge 'dun gyis gnas mal 'bog ③pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos pa'i tshe na dge slong mdza' bo dang / sa las skyes gnyis tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor dang tshe rabs tshe rabs chenas khon yod pas dge slong mdza' bo dang / sa las skyes gnyis tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' dang lhan cig tu 'du 'dzi'i ⑤gtam gyis 'khod pa na/ tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor phyogs der 'ongs pa dang / de gnyis kyis nye dga' la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' yigal te khyod kyang dge 'dun gyis gnas mal 'bog ⑦pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos par gyur na/khyod kyang kho bo cag la 'di lta ste/ dper na tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor bzhin 7—3

du mtho ①'tsham par 'gyur ro/ /nye dga'as ②de gnyis la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gnyis khyed gnyis ③dge 'dun mthun ༷pas dge slong gang duganas mal 'bog ⑥pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos par shes bzhin du de la ngor ⑦'phya'am/de gnyis kyis smras pa/ ci kho bo cag gnyis 'dur ⑧yang mi dbang ngam/dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge 'dun mthun pas dge slong gang gnas mal 'bog pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos par shes bzhin du de la ngor 'phya bar byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la ⑨gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis dge slong mdza' bo dang / sa las skyes gnyis sam/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa de ngor 'phya ba'i grangs su chug shigatso /'di ltar grangs su gzhug 7par bya ste/gnas mal bsham ④pa byas nas/ gaṇḍi tsobardungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la dge slong gcig gis gsol bar bya ste④/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong mdza' bo dang / sa las skyes 'di tsoganyis 'tshal bzhin du dge slong gang dge 'dun mthun pas gnas mal 'bog pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos pa tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor de la ngor 'phya na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi tsodus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzode ⑩cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong mdza' bo dang / sa las skyes 8ngor 'phya ba'i grangs su stsal to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /gang gi tshe dge 'dun gyis dge slong mdza' bo dang / sa las skyes gnyis ngor 'phya ba'i grangs su bcug pa 7—4

de'i tshe na de gnyis tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' dang lhan cig gtam zer zhing 'dug pa na/ tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor phyogs der 'ongs pa dang / de gnyis kyis nye dga' la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' gal te khyod kyang dge 'dun gyis gnas mal 'bog pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos par gyur na/ khyod kyang kho bo cag la ①'di lta ste dper na kha cig bzhin du mtho ②'tsham par 'gyur rol/ /nye dga'as de gnyis la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gnyis khyed gnyis ③dge 'dun mthun pas dge slong gang gnas mal 'bog ④pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos par shes bzhin du de la gzhogs ⑤'phyas byed dam/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ ci kho bo cag gnyis kyis 'ga' zhig gi ming ngam rus nas smos sam/nye dga'as ༅smras pa/ gal te ming dang rus ma smos par gzhogs ⑦'phyas byed du gnang na/ nye dga'as kyang 'jig rten thams cad la ming dang rus mi smos par gzhogs ⑧'phyas byas par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge 'dun mthun pas/ dge slong gang gnas mal 'bog pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos par shes bzhin du de la gzhogs ⑨'phyas byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis dge slong mdza' bo dang /sa las skyes gnyis sam/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa de gzhigs ⑩'phyas byed pa'i grangs su chug shig ⑩'di ltar grangs su gzhug ⑩par bya ste/ gnas mal bsham 0pa byas nas gaṇḍi brdungs te dris pa'i ④tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing tsomathun par gyur pa la 7—5

dge slong gcig gis gsol bar ①bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / dge slong mdza' bo dang / sa las skyes 'di gnyis 'tshal bzhin du dge slong gang dge 'dun mthun pas gnas mal 'bog pa dang / zas la sko ②bar bskos pa tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor de la gzhogs cha'aphyas bgyid dun/gal te dge 'dun gyi ⑤dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong mdza' bo ⑥dang / sa las ⑦skyes gzhogs 'phyas ⑧bgyid pa'i grangs su stsal to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /gang gi tshe dge 'dun gyis dge slong mdza' bo dang / sa las skyes ngor 'phya ba dang / gzhogs ⑨'phyas byed pa'i grangs su bcug pa de'i tshe na de gnyis tshe darngo ldan pa rgyad bu nor la ngor 'phya ⑨ ba dang / gzhogs ⑩'phyas byed nasa'/dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge 'dun mthun pas dge slong gang gnas mal 'bog pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos par shes bzhin du de la ngor 'phya ba dang / gzhogs 'phyas 'byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi ④'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la byasogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la tsosogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong mdza' bo tshudang / sa las skyes gnyis la rmas 8pa/ dge slong khyed gnyis shes bzhin du dge slong gang dge 'dun mthun pas gnas mal 'bog pa dang / zas la sko bar bskos pa 7—6

dge slong gyad bu nor de la ngor 'phya ba dang / gzhogs ①'phyas byed pa bden nam / btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par ②gzigs pas 'dul ba la ②nyan thos rnams kyi ④bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la ⑤sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i ༅nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ 'phya 'am gzhogs ⑦'phyas byed na ltung byed do/ /'phya 'am gzhigs du'aphyas byed na zhes bya ba ni 'phya ba dang gzhogs ⑨'phyas bya ba'i bsam ⑩pas ngag dang / tshig dang /tha snyad dang / skad dang / rjod pa dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / tshig gi lam dang / tshig gi ⑩sgra dang / ngag gi lam tsodang / ngag gi rnam par rig byed rjod ⑫pa'o / /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ④ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dang /⑫ ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang /tshu log par ltung ba dag tu sreg ⑩par byed/ 'tshod par byed/ ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/ des na 8nyung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar (7ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong dge 'dun gyis bgrangs shing / de yang gang zag bcu gnyis su bskos 0pa sbyor ba ma btang ba dag la 'phya na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gzhogs 0'phyas byed na ltung byed du 7—7

'gyur ro/ /'phya ba dang gzhogs ①'phyas byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dge 'dun gyis bgrangs shing de yang gang bag bcu gnyis su bskos pa sbyor ba btang ba dag la 'phya na ltung byed du 'gyuraro/ /gzhogs ②'phyas byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'phya ba dang gzhogs ②'phyas byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dge 'dun gyis bgrangs shing de yang gang zag bcu gnyis su ma bskos pa sbyor ba ma btang ④ba dag la 'phya na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gzhogs ⑤'phyas byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'phya ba dang gzhogs du'aphyas byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dge 'dun gyis ⑦bgrangs shing de yang gang zag bcu gnyis su ma bskos pa sbyor ba btang ⑧ba dag la 'phya na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gzhogs ⑨'phyas byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'phya ba dang gzhogs ⑩'phyas byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dge 'dun gyis ⑪ma bgrangs shing de yang gang zag bcu gnyis su bskos pa sbyor ba ma btang ba dag la 'phya na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /gzhogs tso'aphyas byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'phya ba dang gzhogs 0'phyas byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dge 'dun gyis ma bgrangs shing de yang gang zag bcu gnyis su bskos pa sbyor ba btang ba dag la 'phya na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /gzhogs tso'aphyas byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'phya ba dang gzhogs 8'phyas byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dge 'dun gyis ma bgrangs ⑩shing de yang gang zag bcu gnyis su ma bskos pa sbyor ba ma btang ba dag la 'phya na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /gzhogs ⑩'phyas byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'phya ba dang gzhogs tso'aphyas byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dge 'dun gyis ma bgrangs shing de 7—8

yang gang zag bcu gnyis su ma bskos ①pa sbyor ba btang ba dag la 'phya ②na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /gezhogs ⑧'phyas byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'phya ba dang gzhogs du'aphyas byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang /smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis ④nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /'phya ba'i ltung byed de bcu gnyis pa rdzogs sto༅// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kau shāsbyi ⑦na gdangs can gyi kun dga' ⑧ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na 0tshe dang ldan pa 'dun ⑩pa ltung ba yichos bzhin du phyir mi byed nas/ de la dge slong don 'dod pa/ bde ba 8'dod pa/bde ba la reg par tso'adod pa/ grub pa dang bde ba 'dod pa rnams kyis de la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'dun pa ltung ba byung ba ④chos bzhin du phyir gyis shig /des smras pa/ su la ltung ba byung ba de phyir byed par 'gyur ro/ /khyod la ltung ba byung ba su zhig phyir byed par 'gyur/ su 'gyod par 'gyur ba'o/ /khyod la ltung ba byung ba la su 'gyod par 'gyur/ gal te tshe dang ldan pa khyed cag la ltung ba byung na kho bo'i skemadun du ma 'chags ⑩par gzhan gyi mdun du shogs shig⑩ /tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed 8cag ni rigs sna tshogs dang / rus sna tshogs dang /khyim sna tshogs nas rab tu byung ba dag yin te/ 'di lta ste dper na shing ljon pa dag gi lo ma sna tshogs rlung gis blags ⑥pa dag gcig tu ltung zhing chagacig tu 'dug pa de bzhin du khyed cag kyang rigs sna tshogs dang / rus sna tshogs dang /khyim sna tshogs nas rab tu byung ba dag yin gyi/ kho bo'i 'phags pas ni byang chub thugs su chud pa yin no zhes de dge slong rnams kyis 0bsgo ba rna la gzon 7—9

par byed nas/ dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge slong rnams kyis ①bsgo ba rna la gzon par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan ri'adas la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis dge slong 'dun pa dang gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa la ②bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i grangs su mug shigadu /'di ltar grangs su gzhug ④par bya ste/gnas mal bsham ⑤pa byas nas gaṇḍi ⑥brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo ⑦nas/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la dge slong gcig gis gsol ba bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa 'dun pa 'di ltung ba byung yang chos bzhin du slar mi bgyid de/ 'di la dge slong don 'tshal ba/ phan pa 'tshal ba / bde ba 'tshal ba/ bde ba la reg par ⑧'tshal ba/ grub pa dang bde ba 'tshal ba rnams kyis gzhi des glengs kyang dge slong rnams kyis ⑨bsgo ba rna la gzon na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ⑪ dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis tshe dang ldan pa 'dun pa bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i grangs su stsal to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /gang gi tshe na tshe dang ldan pa 'dun pa bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i grangs su bcug pa de'i tshe na des bsams yipa/ bdag la nyes pa gang byung ba de ni bdag gis de dag la tshig smras pa las 'gyur pa yin te/ gang gis/ skyes bu mkhas dang ldan pa yis/ /ngag rnams ⑩bzhi po bsrung ④bya ste/ /nags kyi nang du gong ma sreg /sgra 'byin pas ni zin la ltos/ /zhes ⑤smras pa ni legs par smras ⑩pa 7—10

yin no snyam nas/ ①de dge slong rnams kyis smras pa na cang mi smra bas/ dge slong rnams kyis ②bsgo me rna la gzon par byed nas/ dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge slong rnams kyis ⑤smras pa na cang mi smra bas dge slong rnams kyis ④bsgo ba rna la dugazon par ⑦byed ces smod par byed/phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis ⑦dge slong 'dun pa'am ⑧gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa de cang mi smra ba ⑨bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i grangs su chug shigatso /'di ltar gzhug ⑩par bya ste/ gnas mal bsham ④pa byas nas gaṇḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo tsonas dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing ④mthun par gyur pa la dge slong gcig gis gsol ba bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang 8ldan pa 'dun pa 'di ltung ba byung yang chos bzhin du slar mi bgyid de/ 'di la dge slong don 'tshal ba/phan pa 'tshal ba/ bde ba 'tshal ba/ bde ba la reg par (9'tshal ba/grub pa dang bde ba 'tshal ⑩ba rnams kyis gzhi des glengs kyang dge slong rnams la cang mi smra bas rna la gzon na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi 8dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis tshe dang ldan pa 'dun pa cang mi smra bas ⑩rna la gzon pa'i grangs su stsal to ⑩/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /gang gi tshe dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'dun pa bsgo ba rna la gzon pa dang / cang mi smra bas rna la gzon pa'i grangs su bcug 0pa de'i tshe na dge slong rnams kyis 'basgo ba rna la gzon pa dang / cang mi smra bas rna la 7—11

gzon par byed nas/ dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge slong rnams kyis ①bsgo ba rna la gzon pa dang / cang mi smra bas rna la gzon par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang gleng gzhi la'adi dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la ①sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen ④bzhin du rmed ⑤par mdzad pa ste zhes byi ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong 'dun pa la rmas ⑥pa/ dge slong khyod dge slong rnams kyis ⑦bsgo ba rna la gzon pa dang / cang mi smra bas rna la gzon pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes ⑧rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la 0nyan thos rnams kyi bslab ⑩pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ bsgo ba rna la yigazon na ltung byed do/ /bsgo ba rna la gzon na zhes bya ba ni bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i bsam pas ngag dang / tshig dang / tha snyad dang / skad dang / rjod pa dang /nges pa'i tshig dang / tshig gi lam dang / tshig gi sgra dang / ngag gi las 7—12

dang / ngag gi rnam par rig byed brjod ①pa'o/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ②ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ②ngan song dang /ngan 'gro dang rjo/ log par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/ 'tshod par byed/ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/ des na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ⑤ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong dge slong gi gan du 'ongs te 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis dge slong skra dang kha spu bregs nas ring po ma lon pa snam sbyar dmar ser dang lhung bzed zha nye'i dbyar 'dab ⑥kyis sbyar ba dang / khar ba ⑦spu bus dkris pa dang / zhun lamar gyi lhung bzed ⑨dam/ 'bru mar gyi lhung bzed dam/ sbrang rtsi'i lhung bzed dam/bu ram gyi dbu ba'i lhung bzed kyis 'ong ba mthong ngam zhes zer ba la/ des 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa kho bos dge slong skra dang kha spu bregs nas ring po ma lon pa chasnam sbyar dmar ser dang lhung bzed zha nye'i dbyar 'dab ⑩kyis sbyar ba dang / khar tsob spu bus dkris 8pa dang / zhun tsomar gyi lhung bzed dam/'bru mar gyi lhung bzed dam/ sbrang rtsi'i lhung bzed dam/'a bu ram gyi dbu ba'i lhung bzed kyis 'ong ba ni ma mthong gi 'di ltar kho bos dge slong rkang pa gnyis kyis 'ong ba mthong ngo zhes smras na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dge slong gi gan du 'ongs te⑩/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis ⑩dge slong ma skra bregs nas ring po ma lon pa snam sbyar dmar ser dang lhung bzed zha nye'i dbyar 'dab 8kyis sbyar ba dang / zhun tsomar gyi lhung bzed dam/ 'bru mar 7—13

gyi lhung bzed dam/ sbrang rtsi'i lhung bzed dam/ bu ram gyi dbu ba'i lhung bzed kyis 'ong ba ①mthong ngam zhes zer ba la/ des 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa kho bos dge slong ma skra bregs nas ring po ma lon pa snam sbyar dmar ser ②dang lhung bzed zha nye'i dbyar 'dab kyis sbyar ba ② dang zhun mar ④gyi lhung bzed dam/ 'bru mar gyi lhung bzed dam/ sbrang rtsi'i lhung bzed dam/ bu ram gyi dbu ba'i lhung bzed kyis 'ongs pa ⑤ni ma ⑥mthong gi/ 'di ltar kho bos dge slong ma rkang pa gnyis kyis ⑦'ong ba mthong ngo zhes smras dun ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong ⑨ma dang dge tshul dang / dge tshul ma la yang de bzhin du ④ci rigs par sbyar ro/ /dge slong dge slong gi gan du 'ongs te/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa ji ltar 0khyim pa bu ram shing gi khur gyis sam/ phyig ma'i 8khur gyis sam/ 'dam tsobu'i khur gyis sam/ shing gi cikhur gyis sam/zhun nyunyemar gyi bum pas sam/ 'bru mar gyi bum pas sam/ sbrang rtsi'i bum pas sam/ bu ram gyi dbu ba'i bum pas 'ong ba mthong ngo ⑩zhes zer ba la/des 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa kho bos khyim pa bu ram shing gi khur gyis sam/snyig ⑩ma'i khur gyis sam/ 'dam bu'i khur gyis sam/ shing gi khur gyis sam/zhun mar gyi bum pas sam/ 'bru mar gyi bum pas sam/ sbrang rtsi'i bum pas sam / bu ram gyi dbu ba'i bum pas 'ongs pa ②ni ma mthong gi 'di ltar kho bos khyim pa rkang pa gnyis kyis bya'ong ba mthong ngo zhes smras na ltung byed du 'gyur ro / /dge slong dge slong gi gan du 'ongs te tshu/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa ji ltar 0khyim pa mo gos thams cad sngon pos sam/ thams cad ser pos sam / thams cad dmar pos (spresam/ thams cad dkar pos ( sresam/7—14

zhun mar gyi ①bum pas sam/ 'bru mar gyi bum pas sam/ sbrang rtsi'i bum pas sam/ bu ram gyi dbu ba'i bum pas 'ong ba mthong ngam zhes zer ba la/des 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa kho bos khyim pa mo gos thams cad sngon pos sam/thams cad ser pos sam/ thams cad dmar pos sam/ thams cad dkar pos sam/ zhun mar gyi bum pas sam/ 'bru mar gyi bum pas sam/ sbrang rtsi'i bum pas sam/ bu ram gyi dbu ba'i bum pas 'ong ba ②ni ma mthong gi/'di ltar kho bos khyim pa mo rkang pa gnyis kyis cha'ong ba mthong ngo zhes smras na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ⑤ji tsam du gzhan 'dri ba la ⑤lan gzhan 'debs na thams cad du ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /rnam grangs de dag thams cad la cang mi smra bas rna la gzon yin nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /gshed ma'i gsad ⑦par bya ba bros nas de ⑤dge slong gi gan du 'ongs 0te 'phags pa ji ltar gsad ⑩par bya ba mthong ngam zhes 'dri na/ gal te grang ba'i dus yin na shyidage slong gis 8gshed ma la bzhin bzangs 8me khang du zhugs la me 'de ④shig ces brjod 8par bya'o/ /gal te tsha ba'i dus yin na bzhin bzangs chuje dpong sa'i khang par zhugs shig /je skom 'thung ⑩shig /je ngal so shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /gal te des de 8skad ces bdag mi 0grang ngo / /bdag mi tsha'o/ /bdag mi skom mo/ /bdag ma chad do/ /'di ltar bdag gsad 0par bya ba 'dri'o zhes zer na/ je sen mo la bltas 0te sen mo mthong ngo zhes brjod par bya'o / /nam mkha' la bltas 6te nam mkha' mthong ngo zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te phye'adi skad ces bdag sen ④mo mi 'dri'o/ /bdag nam mkha' mi 'dri'o//'di ltar bdag gsad byapar bya ba 'dri'o zhes zer na/ dge slong des phyogs 7—15

bzhir rnam par bltas te 'du byed thams cad bdag med pa yid la byas nas don dam par na sems can ma mthong ngo ①zhes brjod par bya ba la ltung ba med do//kha na ba dang / khas sman 'dzin pa la ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang /smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la ②dge slong rnams kyis zhus pa/btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa 'dun pa tshangs pa mtshungs ③par spyod pa rnams kyi ngag mi ༅nyan nas bsgo ba rna la gzan pa dang / cang mi smra bas rna la gzon pa'i grangs su stsal ba la gzigs/ dge slong dag da ⑤ltar du ma zad kyi 'di ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang 'di dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi yingag mi nyan nas tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar gyur ⑦te/ de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i ⑧dus na rdzing zhig na rus 0sbal gcig dang ngang pa gnyis shig 'khod de/ de ⑨ nas dus gzhan zhig na lo bcu gnyis su than pa byung nas des rdzing de bskam 7par brtsams so/ /chos nyid kyis na 'jig rten gnas pa chags nas ring po ma lon pa'i tshe na dud 'gro dag kyang smra shes pas ngang pa gnyis kyis rus 0sbal la smras pa/ grogs po kho bo cag gnyis ni rdzing gzhan du 'gro'o/ /rus tsosngal gyis smras pa/ grogs po gnyis kho bo yang khrid de song shig /ngang pa gnyis kyis smras pa/ khyod ji ltar khrid de 'gro bar bya/rus ④sngal gyis smras pa/ kho bo 8shing gi dbus su khas gzung bar byas/ khyed gnyis kyis rtse mo gnyis nas zung ⑩la deng shig /ngang pa gnyis kyis smras pa/khyod smra 'dod pa yin pas tshig srung mi nus kyis 0kho bo cag gnyis khyer te mi 'gro'o / /rus 8sngal gyis smras payi/ tshig bsrung bar bya'o/ /ngang pa 7—16

gnyis kyis rus ①sbal de khyer te steng gi nam mkha' la 'phags nas ji tsam na ri brags zhig gi steng na par song ba dang / khye'u dang bu mo dag gis mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag ltos shig ngang pa gnyis kyis rus ①sbal zhig khyer te song ngo zhes zer ba na/ rus ③sngal des kyang dang du blangs so/ /de nas ri brags gzhan zhig gi steng na phar song ba dang / yang khye'u dang bu mo dag gis mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag ltos shig /ngang pa gnyis kyis rus ④sngal zhig khyer te song ngo zhes zer ba dang / rus ⑤sngal des bsams ⑥pa/ bdag gis yun ji srid du mtho ⑦'tsharma pa mnags par bya snyam nas smras pa/ ngang pa gnyis kyis kho bo khyer ba ma yin gyis ⑧'di ltar kho bo ⑨rang 'gro'o zhes byas pa dang / shing shor nas de sa la lhung ste/ de dag gis bzung nas tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar byas pa dang lhas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ mdza' bshes 0phan par 'dod rnams kyis/ /smras pa gang zhig mi 'dzin pa/ /rus ⑩sngal gyis ni shing btang ltar/ /de ni lhung zhing las par 'gyur8—/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na ngang pa ches rgan 8shos gang yin pa de ni nga yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na ngang pa cig 8shos gang yin pa de ni kun dga' bo yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na rus 0sbal gang yin pa de ni 'dun pa 'di yin te/ 'di de'i tshe na yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi ngag mi nyan pas tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar gyur la/ da ⑩ltar yang 'di tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi ngag mi nyan pas bsgo ba rna la gzon pa dang / cang mi smra bas rna la gzon pa'i grangs su bcug go/ /bsgo skyab rna la gzon pa'i ltung byed de bcu gsum pa rdzogs sto// //7—17

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal marten med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na khyim bdag gcig ①gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun ni bzhugs 0so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par bsgrubs sol/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ②ni rgyu lngas rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par sgrub ④par mdzad de/ lnga gang zhe na/ nang du yang dag 'jog la ⑤bzhed pa dang / lha rnams la chos ston par bzhed pa dang /nad pa la lta bar bzhed pa dang / gnas mal la ༅rtog par bzhed pa dang /'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pa'o/ /don 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das gnas mal la rtog ⑦par bzhed pa dang /'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ⑧bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' 0bar bzhed pas rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par sgrub par ⑩mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 4〉dge slong gi dge 'dun song nas ring po ma ⑫lon par thugs su chud nas lde mig bsnams te kun dga'i ra ba nas kun dga'i ra bar gtsug tshulag khang nas gtsug lag khang du/ khang khyim nas khang khyim du/'chag sa nas 'chag sa ④dang / gol bar gshegs shing mthar gyis gshegs pa na / khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang zhig ga la ba der gshegs so/ /de'i tshe na khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang de na gnas mal rab tu mang po dag bla gab 8med par bzhag cing / dus ma yin pa'i sprin chen po yang 'dus par 7—18

gyur ①rto/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag ②khang de na gnas mal rab tu mang po dag bla gab med par bzhag cing dus ma yin pa'i sprin chen po 'dus ①pa yang gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang e ma zhes gsung zhing smad nas 'di snyam du dgongs te④/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis pags ⑤pa dang / sha dang khrag dag bcir cing bcir cing sbyin pa dag sbyin / bsod nams ⑥dag byed pa gang yin pa de la dge slong dag drod mi shes pa dang / so sor mi rtog par yongs su longs spyod do snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul gyis dus ma yin pa'i sprin chen po de phyir dgag pa mdzad de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul gyis dgag pa mdzad pas de steng gi bar snang la chu lon lta bur gyur te/ mtha' na ⑦'dug cing shas cher bcom ldan 'das la sdod cing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas mal rab tu mang po de dag skyabs yod par brubs ⑧nas dbyar gyi na bza' ras chen bsnams te sku bsil bar bzhed nas bang rim na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dus ma yin pa'i sprin chen po de dgag pa'i rdzu 'phrul de slar bsdu ba mdzad de0/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul de slar bsdu ba mdzad nas 'brug grags shing char gyis gshong dang thang thams cad tshim par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sku dag bsil nas zhabs gnyis bsil te/ nang du yang dag 'jog gi slad du gtsug lag khang du gshegs so/ /de nas dge slong bsod snyoms sgrub pas bsod snyoms blangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos nyid kyis bsod snyoms sgrub pa'i dge slong la/ dge slong ji lta ⑨ zas bsod dam/7—19

dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par byas sam zhes so sor kun dga' bar mdzad pa ①yin pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ②dge slong bsod snyoms sgrub ②pa la/dge slong ji lta zas bsod dam/ dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par byas sam zhes so sor kun dga' bar mdzad pa dang / des gsol pa/ btsun pa te por zas bsod cing / dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par bgyis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad nas gtsug lag khang gi slad rol du zhabs gnyis bsil te/ nang du yang dag 'jog gi slad du gtsug lag khang du gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyi dro nang du yang dag 'jog dulas bzhengs nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas 'di na dge slong gi dge 'dun song nas ring po ma lon par shes nas/ lde mig khyer te kun dga'i ra ba nas kun dga'i ra bar/gtsug lag khang nas gtsug lag khang du/ khang khyim nas khang khyim du/'chag ⑤sa nas 'chag sa yidang / gol bar song zhing mthar gyis 'gro ba ⑦na/khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang zhig ga la ba der phyin nas/ ngas khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang de na gnas mal rab tu mang po dag bla gab med par bzhag cing dus ma yin pa'i sprin chen po 'dus pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang e ma zhes byas te smad nas/ 'di snyam du bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis pags ⑧pa dang / sha dang khrag dag bcir cing bcir cing 0sbyin pa dag sbyin / bsod nams dag byed pa gang yin pa de la dge slong dag drod ⑨ mi shes pa dang / so sor mi rtog par yongs su longs spyod ⑩do snyam du dgongs 7—20

kyis ①dge slong dag khyed kyis dad pas sbyin par bya ba la drod ran par yongs su longs spyad ②pa dang / spang zhing ①yongs su longs spyad ④pa dang / 4dus su yongs su longs spyad pa dang / brtag ⑤cing yongs su ༅longs spyad pa dang /khad kyis yongs su longs spyad ⑦na legs so// // bar sdom la②/ drod ran pa dang spang ba ⑨dang / /de bzhin dus dang brtag ⑩pa dang / /khad kyis yongs su spyad pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drod ran pa dang / spang ba dang / dus dang / brtag pa dang /khad kyis yongs su longs spyod pa'i bsngags ⑩pa brjod nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi 'baslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i 8nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge 'dun gyi cikhri'am/ khri'u 'am/ stan nang tshangs ④can nam/ la ba'am/ sngas sam / gor bu bla gab med par bting ngam 'ding du bcug nas ma bsdus sam/sdud du ma bcug par de nas song na ltung byed do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis tso'adul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ⑩bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar tsomadzad do/ /dge slong rab tu mang tsopo dag don mthun dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur dong ba na ri brags shig tu phyin nas/ de dag gis du ri brags der gnas bca' 0bar brtsams pa dang / ri brags de na gtsug lag khang zhig yod nas de na de dag la mi zhig gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed cag gtsug lag khang du mi gnas sam / bzhin bzangs ④mi gnas te kho bo cag ni don mthun la rag las pa 7—21

yin pas/ gal te kho bo cag gtsug lag khang du ①gnas par gyur na don mthun gyis kho bo cag bor te 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bzhud ②la gtsug lag khang du gzims shig dang / don mthun cha ②ba'i dus kyi tshe ④bdag gis 'phags pa dag bslang bar bgyi'o/ /de dag gtsug lag khang du dong ste gnas mal bshams nas nyal ba dang / don mthun chas te/glang tha ma bkal zin pa dang / de nas mi de sad ⑤nas de song ste dge slong rnams la smras pa/ 'phags pa dag yidon mthun chas kyis 0myur du spyon cig /de dag ji srid du lag pa dag bsnyal ⑧bar byed/ so shing dag 'dor bar byed/gnas mal dag gtong bar ⑨byed pa de srid du don mthun thal bar gyur tshunas/de dag phyi bzhin 'brang zhing 'dong ba na chom rkun pa dag gis bcom par gyur nas de dag mthar gyis gtsug lag khang du phyin pa dang / de dag dge slong rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'ongs pa legs so 'ongs pa yilegs so/ /ji lta chubade bar brgyus sam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bde bar brgyus re skan/ ci nyes/ tshe dang ldan pa dag kho bo cag chom rkun pa dag gis bcom mo ④zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong 'khod pa dag la bcol bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong 'khod pa dag la bcol bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ mnyan yod na khyim bdag gnyis shig 'khod pa de gnyis phan tshun khon yod cing gcig ④ni dad pa dang ldan pa yin la/gcig ④ni ma dad pa yin nas/ dad pa can gyis bsams ⑩pa/ khon spel bas ci bya ste/ khon zhi bar byas 0song la rab tu 'byung bar bya'o snyam nas de 7—22

rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ste dge slong gi gan du rab tu byung ①ngo / /khyim bdag ma dad pa shos des mi zhig la dris pa/ bzhin bzangs lakhyim bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba de gar song / des smras pa/ rab tu byung ngo / / gang du/③shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams kyi nang du'o/ /ci de mi 'jigs pa'i rgong khyer yin nam / kho bo der yang song la de la gnod par ④bya'o/ /'jig rten ni mdza' bshes ⑤dang / dgra bo dang / tha mal pa yin pas gzhan zhig de'i gan du song ste 0smras pa/ khyod la khyim bdag de gshe'o/ /des bsams ⑦pa/bdag nyes dmigs dugang gis rab tu byung ba'i nyes dmigs de nyid kyis rjes su 'brel to snyam nas de mkhan po'i drung du song ste/ smras pa/ mkhan po bdag nyes dmigs gang gis rab tu byung ba'i nyes ⑨dmigs de nyid kyis rjes su 'brel bar gyur gyis ⑩mchi'o/ /bu gang du 'gro/ rgyal po'i khab tu'o/ /de ltar gyis shig /de rgyal po'i khab tu 'phags pa dang / khyim bdag de yang rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'ongs nas dge slong la dris pa/ 'phags pa khyim bdag ⑩'di zhes bgyi ba de ci rab tu byung ngam/ rab tu byung ngo / /de gar mchis/⑫rgyal po'i khab tu song ngo / /des bsams 8pa/ ci de mi 'jigs pa'i grong khyer yin nam/ bdag der yang song la de la tsomatshams gcad 8par bya'o snyam nas de yang rgyal po'i khab tu 'phags so/ /dge slong ni dus su ⑩'gro zhing dus ma yin par ⑩mi 'gro la/ khyim pa ni dus su yang 'gro'/ dus ma yin par yang 'gro bas dge slong de ri brags kyi gtsug lag khang zhig tu zhugs pa dang /khyim bdag des mthong nas des bsams 0pa/ gal te bdag gis 'di la cung zad smra ba'i rigs na 'di'i grogs dge slong dag mang bas bdag la gnod pa 7—23

byed par 'gyur gyis ①bdag gis sang 'di shes par bya'o snyam mo/ /dge slong de yang nang par sngar langs te dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag 'gros gnas mal 'de ②re zhes gnas mal gtad pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ khyod gar 'grol/ rgyal po'i khab tu'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa lam 'di ni dogs pa dang bcas pa yin gyis ④'di nas ma 'gro shigadu /'di ni lam gzhan yin gyis ⑥de nas song zhig /de lam de nas song ba dang /khyim bdag de yang nang par sngar langs ⑦nas gtsug lag khang du song ste dge slong la dris pa/ 'phags pa dudage slong 'di zhes bgyi ba gar mchis/ rgyal po'i khab tu'o/ /shul gang nas/ che ge mo zhig nas so/ /de de'i phyi bzhin song ba dang / dge slong des de ⑨mthong nas des de la smras pa/ bzhin bzangs khon ⑩zhi bar gyur cig /des smras pa/ da 0zhi bar bya'o zhes khyim bdag des dge slong de shin tu brdeg brdeg nas lhung bzed kyang bcag /chos gos dag 8kyang dral te tha ma ma shi 8tsam byas te btang skenas/ dbugs de'u chad pa las sos te phyime log nas gtsug lag khang de nyid du phyin pa dang /dge slong rnams kyis de mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa ci'i phyir khyod gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur/ des skabs de dge slong rnams la rgyas par brjod nas yang smras pa/ gal te kho bos tshe dang ldan pa dag gis bstan pa ltar ma byas na kho bo gnas skabs 'di 'dra bar mi 'gyur ro zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis 8bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de 'dra ba'i rkyen ma gtogs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa 'dod pa dang / bslab pa la gus pa dang / bslab pa 7—24

la yo byad bsnyungs pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la de dang mthun pa dang / de'i shas che ba dang / de dang 'tsham pa'i bka' mchid mdzad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na snga ma ni bcas pa yin la/ 'di ni gnang ba yin te/ nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya te①/ yang dge slong gang dge 'dun gyi lakhri'am/ khri'u'am/ stan nang tshangs can nam/ la ba'am/ sngas sam/gor bu bla gab med par bting ngam/ 'ding du bcug nas ma bsdus sam/sdud du ma bcug gam/ dge slong 'khod pa la ma bcol bar de nas song na de 'dra ba'i rkyen ma gtogs ②te ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o/ /dge 'dun gyi ④zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi ⑤dge 'dun gyi'o/ /khri zhes bya ba ni khri nyid do/ /khri'u zhes bya ba ni khri'u nyid do/ /stan nang tshangs can zhes bya ba ni shing bal can no/ /la ba zhes bya ba ni la ba nyid do/ /sngas zhes ⑥bya ba ni sngas su gzhug ⑦pa'o/ /gor bu zhes bya ba ni gru bzhi'o/ /bla gab med par zhes bya ba ni ma g.yogs par ro/ /bting ngam zhes bya ba ni rang gis so/ /'ding du bcug nas zhes bya ba ni gzhan no/ /ma bsdus sam zhes bya ba ni rang gis so/ /sdud du ma bcug gam zhes bya ba ni gzhan no/ /dge slong 'khod pa la zhes bya ba ni de na dge slong gang 'dug pa ⑧la'o / /ma bcol bar zhes bya ba la bcol ba ni rnam pa lnga ste/ gtsug lag khang 'de 0re zhes bya ba dang / gtsug lag khang ltos shig ces bya ba'amatho)/ gnas mal 'de re zhes bya ba dang /yi gnas mal sdus shig ⑩ces bya ba dang /sgo 8lcags chug shig ④ces bya ba ④nyid ni tsolnga pa'o/ /gal te dge slong med na 7—25

dge tshul la bcol bar bya'o/ /gal te dge tshul med na khyim bdag la bcol bar bya'o/ /gal te khyim bdag med na phyogs bzhir rnam par bltas te lde mig sbas nas 'gro bar bya'o/ /gal te lam kur ①dge slong mthong na kho bos phyogs ga ge mo zhig tu lde mig sbas kyis long shig ces ②brjod par bya'o/ /de nas song na zhes bya ba ni nyen kor ③spangs na'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ④'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa dge slong gi ⑤gnas mal gyi nyen kor gang lags⑥/ nye ba ⑦'khor ngas bram ze gro bzhin ⑤skyes la a mra'i sdong po shin tu me tog phun sum tshogs pa/ 'bras bu phun sum 0tshogs ṅge/yal ga'i tshogs phun sum 0tshogs pa 'dom bdun yigyis bar du chod pa'i a mra'i ⑫sdong po bdun po gang dag yin pa de dag la 'dom bzhi bcu rtsa dgu yod par bstan pa de ni dge slong gi tsoganas mal gyi nyen kor ④yin no/ /de 'dra ba'i rkyen ma gtogs te zhes bya ba ni de 'dra ba'i rkyen bzhag ste'o/ /ltung byed do zhes pa 8ni sems can dmyal rtsab dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ⑩ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang / log par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/'tshod par byed/ ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/des na 7ltung byed do zhes gsungs so// de la ltung bar ⑩ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong gis dge 'dun gyi du gnas mal bla gab med par bzhag ste de nas song na ji srid du nyen kor ⑥ma spangs kyi bar du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ nyen kor 'aspangs na dultung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gal te lam kur bdag gi phyedage 'dun gyi phyoganas mal 2—26

shos 'di lta ①bu zhig tu gzhag ②go snyam du dran zhing / gal te de ③'di snyam du bdag gi ④tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa mkhas pa dag sdud par 'gyur ro snyam na dge slong des phyin cad ⑤de ltar mi bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya zhing tshig tu yang brjod par bya ste ltung ba de yang chos bzhin du ༅phyir bya'o/ /gal te lam kur dge slong der 'gro ba mthong zhing / gal te de 'di snyam du ⑦'dis sdud ⑧par 'gyur ro snyam na de la 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa kho bos dge 'dun gyi ⑨gnas mal phyogs ga ge mo zhig tu bzhag pa de sdus ⑩shig ces brjod par bya zhing dge slong des phyin cad ⑩de ltar mi bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya zhing tshig tu yang brjod par bya ste ltung ba de yang chos bzhin du phyir bya'o/ /dge slong des kyang dge slong de tshul khas blangs nas gus par bya ste bsdu bar bya'o/ /gal te sdud par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /gal te der son ⑫nas bdag gis 8dge 'dun gyi gnas mal phyogs 'di lta bu zhig tu gzhag 0go snyam du dran zhing gal te de 'di snyam du bdag gi tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa mkhas pa dag sdud par 'gyur ro snyam na(lha/ dge slong des phyin cad 4)de ltar mi bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya zhing tshig tu yang brjod par bya ste ltung ba de yang chos bzhin du phyir bya'o/ /gal te der son tsonas dge slong der 'gro ba mthong zhing / gal te de ⑩'di snyam du 'dis sdud par 'gyur ro snyam na de la 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa kho bos dge 'dun gyi 0 gnas mal phyogs ga ge mo zhig tu bzhag pa de sdus 0shig ces brjod par bya zhing dge slong des phyin cad ④de ltar mi bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya zhing tshig tu yang brjod par bya ste ltung ba de yang chos bzhin du phyir bya'o/ /dge slong des kyang dge slong de la 7—27

khas blangs ①nas gus par bya ste bsdu bar ②bya'o/ /gal te sdud par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge 'dun gyi gnas mal bla gab med par bzhag nas gtsug lag khang du 'dir bdag gis sems mnyam ③par ma bzhag pa mnyam par gzhag go snyam pa'am/ sems mnyam par bzhag pa rnam par grol bar bya'o snyam pas nang du yang dag 'jog gi phyir 'jug par byed cing / de ting nge 'dzin de las mtshan mo'i thun dang po'am/ thun phyed na ldang bar byed na gal te gnas mal phan phun du ma gyur na nyes byas su 'gyur la/gal te phan phun du gyur na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge 'dun gyi thuganas mal bla gab med par bzhag nas gtsug lag khang du 'dir bdag gis ⑤sems mnyam par ma bzhag pa mnyam par gzhag go snyam pa'am/ sems mnyam par bzhag pa rnam par grol bar bya'o snyam pas nang du yang dag 'jog gi phyir 'jug par byed cing de ting nge 'dzin de las mtshan mo'i gung thun nam/ thun tha ma'am/ skya rengs ⑥ma shar ba'am/ skya rengs ⑦shar ba'am/ nyi ma ma shar ba'am/ nyi ma shar ba'am/ nyi ma'i brgyad cha shar ba'am/ nyi ma'i bzhi cha shar ba'am/ phyed ma yol ba'am/ phyed yol ba'am/ nyi ma'i bzhi cha lus pa'am/ nyi ma'i brgyad cha lus pa'am/ nyi ma ma nub pa'am/ nyi ma nub pa'am/ rgyu skar dag ma shar ba'am/ rgyu skar dag shar ba na ldang bar byed na/ gal te gnas mal phan phun du ma gyur na nyes byas su 'gyur la/gal te phan phun du gyur na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑧'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa gnas mal gyi phan phun du mchis/ nye ba ⑨'khor gnyis te/ rlung gi phan phun dang / char pa'i 7—28

phan phun no/ /rlung gi phan phun gang zhe na/ rim pa gcig nas ①rim pa gnyis pa'i ②bar du bzlog par gyur pa'o②/ /char pa'i phan phun gang zhe na/ rim pa gcig nas rim pa gnyis pa'i bar du thal bar gyur pa'o// //bar sdom la/ chos bstan pa dang mgron ④'bod dang / /gtsug lag khang dang chos nyan ⑤dang / /'dug pa dang ⑥ni gnyis po dang / /sku gzugs dang ni nad pa dang / /stan dang lnga dang gcig la gnyis/ /phyi bzhin 'gro dang grogs bya dang / /kha ton pa dang zhu ba dang / / stan bkur ⑦ba dang zan bcad ⑧dang / /brub ⑨pa dang ni bcol ba dang / /me dang chu yang de bzhin no/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag dge slong dag gi gan du 'ongs te smras pa/ 'phags pa dag chos bstan du gsol/ dge slong dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di na tho )bzhugs kyis6〉/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'gan du deng shig dang / bcom ldan 'das ston par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa dag ston pa nyag gcig lags pas re zhig lha rnams la chos ston tam/'on te klu rnams la'am/ 'on te gnod sbyin rnams la'am/ 'on te dri za rnams la'am/ 'on te mi rnams la chos ston sus 'tshal gyis khyed ⑫ kyis kyang ston cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na rjes su gnang gis tsodage slong rnams kyis kyang chos bstan par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis kyang chos bstan par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong dag 'greng bzhin du chos ston par byed pa na 8de dag skye bo phal po che'i tshogs kyis yongs su 7—29

bskor bar gyur nas/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis ⑨smras pa/'di dag skyes 'bul ba dag 'ongs pa yin nam ci zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dug ste chos bstan par bya'o/ /dge slong dag rang rang gi stan dag thogs te 'dong ba na ma dad pa dag gis mthong nas rol mo ltar 'dong ngam ci zhes co 'dri bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang gis sridage 'dun gyi stan dag nye bar gzhag par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyi stan dag nye bar gzhag par rjes su gnang ba khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis thos nas/ des dge 'dun la khri lnga brgya phul ba dang / de dag thams cad chos ston par byed pa na ca cor gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gcig gis chos bstan ③par bya'o/ /de dag gis gang gis bstan par bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi ④gnas brtan nas bzung ste/ dge 'dun gyi gsar bu'i bar gyis chos bstan ⑤par bya'o/ /gal te gsar bu'i mtha' dag mechos ston par byed pa na/ rgan pa'i mtha' dag mi brjid par gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'dug ste ⑦chos bstan par bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan mi brjid par gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgan pa'i mtha' logs su stan gnyis sam gsum bzhag ste chos bstan par bya'o/ /der yang chos ston pa mi brjid 7—30

par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgan pa'i mtha' logs su stan gnyis sam gsum bzhag ste seng ge'i khri bsham par bya'o/ /chos ston pa ①'dzeg dka' nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te phyogs nges pa yin na so phag dag gis them skas bya'o/ /gal te phyogs nges pa ma yin na shing dag gis them skas bya'o/ /de mchil ma 'dor bas yid du mi 'ong bar ⑤gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mchil ma'i snod ②gzhag par bya'o/ /der sbrang bu dag 'du ④nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑤bka' stsal pa/ gcal blug ⑥par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis ci zhig blug ⑦pa mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bye ma'am thal ba blug ⑧par bya'o/ /de dri nga bar gyur ⑨nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dus dus su sbyang ba 4) dang bskam par bya'o/ /de dag gral tshar gcig kho nar tho〉ring por shom par byed pa na gzhon 4)pa'i mtha' dag gis mi thos nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas mal rnam pa gnyis su bsham par bya ste/ zla gam gyi rnam pa lta bu'am/ rdzing bu'i rnam pa lta bur 8ro/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis dge slong rnams khyim gzhan du mgron ⑫du bos pa na dge slong dag dang du mi len tshunas/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gang gi skyetshe sangs rgyas 'jig rten du ma byung ba de'i tshe na ni mu stegs can dag sbyin gnas lags mod/ da ⑩ni bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung bas khyed cag sbyin gnas lags te/ gal te khyed cag dang du mi bzhes na/ ci bdag cag dge ba'i shul rgyags tsom mchis par 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du mchi bar yibagyi'am zhes 7—31

zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dang du blang bar bya'o/ /de dag stan dag g.yar po byed pa na dge slong rnams kyis mi ster nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stan dag brnyan par bya'o/ /dge slong dag zan zos nas / stan de dag khyer te 'dong ba na de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed bzhud cig dang bdag cag gis ①'tshal te mchi'o zhes zer ②ba na/dge slong dag 'gyod pas mi 'jog nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gzhag par bya'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag chaskom mnabs te bzhud kyi bar du re zhig ④gzhes shig ces zer ba na dge slong dag mi sdod nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bsdad ⑤par bya'o/ /de dag la de lta bu'i rkyen byung nas des na stan de dag mi skyel ༅nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis blang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas de dag gis gang gis blang ba ⑦mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas pa dag gis gaṇḍi nichung ngu brdungs te blang bar bya'o/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gtsug lag khang du lhags te dge slong dag mgron 0du 'bod pa na dge slong dag dang du mi len nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dang du blang bar bya'o/ /de dag dge slong dag zan zos nas stan dag g.yar po byed pa na ⑩dge slong dag gis mi ster nas de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ⑩bdag cag ni khyed la bshos gsol ba lags na/ khyed kyis bdag cag la stan dag mi g.yar ram zhes zer nas ⑩bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stan dag brnyan par bya'o/ /de 7—32

dag gis de nyid du bor te dong ba na de dag ma byin par len pa dag gis brkus nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ①bka' stsal pa/ bsrung ②ba'i dge slong gzhag par bya'o/ /de ②de dag gi dunang nyid du zhugs pa dang de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa ci yang bzhed ⑤dam/ des smras pa/ kho bo mi 'dod de/ 'di ltar kho bo stan dag srung ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci bdag cag khyed ⑥kyi gdan dag rku ④snyam mamadu/ gal te thugs mi ches na snoms te bzhud cig ces ⑨zar nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i nang du 'jug par mi bya bar mtha' gcig tu 'dug ⑩ste/ gal te kha ton pa yin na ni des kha ton bya zhing de la yang sems gtad par bya'o/ /gal te spong ba pa yin na ni des kyang ⑩mtha' gcig tu 'dug ste yid la bya ba bskyed par bya zhing de la yang sems gtad par bya'o/ /gang gi tsotshe dong bar gyur pa de'i tshe na brub par bya'o/ /de dag chang gi tshigs ma dang / snum dang / bshang ba dang / gci skyibs ma rung bar gyur pa na dge slong dag 'dor bar byed nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag dor bar mi bya bar gang dag chang gi tshigs mas tsom rung bar gyur pa de dag ni chu dag ④gis sbyang bar bya'o/ /gang dag snum gyis ma rung bar ⑩gyur pa de dag ni chal gyis sbyang bar bya'o/ /gang dag bshang tho)ba dang gci 4)bas ma rung bar gyur pa de dag ni sa'am/'dag rdzas sam/ lci bas sbyang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos mnyan par bya'o/ /zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong dag bla gab med par byed pa na nyi ma tsha yinas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bla re gdags par bya'o/ /rlung dang char byung nas de dag gis gnas mal bor te 7—33

'dong bas ①de ma rung bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/brub par bya'o/ /de dag gis sus ②brub pa mi shes te/ su gang la la ②'dug pa des ④de 'brub par byed pa na rgan pa'i mtha' dag la gzhi bzang po bshams pa de dag dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan ⑤dag gis brub ⑥par mi nus nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ⑦rgyan pa'i mtha' dag gi ⑤ni gzhon pa rnams kyis brub ⑨par bya zhing / gzhon pa'i mtha' dag gi ni rgan pa rnams kyis brub 0par bya'o/ /brubs yinas tshoms gcig tu byed pas de dag ma rung bar 'gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mthun pa dang mthun par gzhag par bya'o/ /de dag phyis chos mnyan pa mi byed nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ g.yogs pa'am/ bla gab med par bya'o / /de ltar chos nyan pa na bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis nor bus spras pa dang / gser dang dngul gyis brgyan pa'i gos dag gis seng ge'i khri bshams pa dang / dge slong dag tso'agyod pas mi 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim pa'i gos dag yin par bya ste/ mi rtag pa nyid yid la bya bas zil gyis mnan nas 'dug par bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod ④par mi bya'o/ /dbe slong dag dge 'dun gyi tsoganas mal mi 'brub ⑩cing de nyid ⑩du 'dor ba na de dag ma rung bar 'gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag kyang brub par bya'o/ /khyim bdag gcig tshul gtsug lag khang dgon pa dang / grong mtha' pa gnyis yod nas de'i gtsug lag khang grong mtha' pa na ni gnas mal mang du yod la/ gtsug lag khang dgon pa na ni gnas mal nyung ngo / /dus gzhan zhig na dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang du dus 7—34

ston byung nas/ dge slong dgon pa pa dag gi ①gong mtha'i gtsug lag khang nas gnas mal g.yar ba dang / dge slong grong mtha' pa dag gis ma ②ster nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ brnyan ②par bya'o/ /gal te char 'bab bam/ char 'bab du dogs na brnyan par mi bya'o/ /lam kur rlung dang / char bab pas de dag ma rung bar ④gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shing ljon pa'i drung ngam/ rtsig drung du bcer te rdzas gcig gis g.yog ⑤par bya'o/ /de dag rdzas bzang pos g.yog ⑥par byed nasal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rdzas ngan pas g.yog ⑦par bya'o / /dus ston zin nas de dag gtsug lag khang 'di yang khyim bdag de'i yin no snyam nas ③phyir mi 'bul nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mthus dgug par bya'o/ /ngo mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gnas mal 'di ni 0khyim bdag che ge mo zhig gi dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang gi yin no/ /'di ni grong mtha'i gtsug lag khang gi yin no zhes yi ge bri ⑫ zhing gnas mal ji ltar nges par byas pa ⑩bzhin du longs spyad 8par bya'o/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das bgres 8pa'i mtha' logs na bzhugs pa de'i tshe na bgres 8pa'i mtha' brjid par gyur cing / gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das bgres pa'i mtha' logs na mi bzhugs pa de'i tshe na bgres pa'i mtha' mi brjid (9par gyur na/ gal 7—35

te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bzhugs pa'i sku gzugs bgyid du stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gnang gis ①byed du chug shig② /des 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bzhugs pa'i ②sku gzugs byed du bcug ste/ de rgan pa'i mtha' logs su bzhag go/ /rlung dang char pa byung nas dge slong rnams kyis de bor te dong ba dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag khyed kyis ston pa yang bor ro zhes smod par byed nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ④stsal pa/ khyim pa'am/ dge tshul gyis spyan drang bar bya'o/ /khyim pa yang med/ dge tshul yang med nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams kyis ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed de spyan drang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag na bar gyur nas de dag la ⑤su yang mi lta nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nad pa dus gsum du blta bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis nad pa dus gsum du blta bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ de dag gis gang gis blta bar bya ba ⑥mi shes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi ⑦gnas brtan nas bzung ste dge 'dun gyi ⑧gsar bu'i bar gyis blta bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis nad pa blta ⑨bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag nad pa ⑩lta bar byed pa na/ de dag 'greng bzhin du nad pa lta bar byed pas nad pa dag 0nyam nga bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dug ste nad pa blta bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dug ste nad pa blta bar bya'o/ /zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong dag rang rang gi stan dag khyer te 'dong 8ba na ma dad pa dag 'phags pa 7—36

dag rol mo ltar 'dong ngam ci zhes mtho ①'tsham pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/stan dag khyer te 'dong bar mi bya bar 'di ②ltar nad g.yog gis stan deg bsham par bya'o/ /drug sde dag nad pa ltar dong ②ba na de dag rjode nyid na 'du 'dzi'i gtam gyis yun ring ༷du 'khod nas nad g.yog rnams kyis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag nad pa'i bya ba yongs su nyams par gyur gyis deng shigadu /de dag gis smras pa/ de yang gyis la gnas mal yang ltos shig dang de ltar ⑦na nad pa shi ba'i yo byad drug 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang khyed nad pa'i bya ba yongs su nyams par ma byed par deng shig ⑧dang kho bo cag 0gis blta bar bya'o / /nad g.yog de ⑩dag gis nad pa la ma bcol bar dong yib dang / drug sde dag kyang dong nas rlung dang char pa dag 'byung ba na nad pas gnas mal rtul ma nus nas de dag ma rung bar gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag lnga po 'di dag la bcol bar mi bya ste/ ngo tsha med pa dang / nad dang bcas pa dang / rgas pa 'khogs shing nyam chung ba dang / na ba sbyor mi bzod pa dang / rdzogs par ma bsnyen pa thams cad la'o// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bzhi bcu rtsa 'bazhi pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba 8'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun ⑫pa khri gcig la dge slong gnyis mchis na de gang dag gis brub par bgyi/ gang phyis langs pas so/ /gnyis ka tsodus gcig tu langs na tshugazhon pas so/ / gnyi ga tsogazhon na gnyi gas brub par bya'o/ /slob dpon dang mkhan po dag 7—37

'chag tu dong ①ba na dge slong lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas gtsug lag khang na 'khod pa na de dag chu med pa ②nas utpa la bzhin du dge ba'i chos rnams kyis mi 'phel nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag gis slob dpon dang / mkhan po dag gi phyi bzhin 'gro bar bya'o/ /slob dpon dang / mkhan po dag stan ②dag khyer te 'dong zhing ④lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag lag pa brkyang ste 'gro nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag gis slob dpon dang / mkhan po dag gi stan dag khyer te 'gro bar bya'o/ /slob dpon dang mkhan po de ⑤dag 'chags na yiphyag dar byed pa na lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag lag pa brkyang ste 'khod nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag gis phyags ma blangs te/ slob dpon dang / mkhan po dag snying las chung ngur bya'o/ /mkhar lan byed par bskos na ni ltung ba med do/ /slob dpon dang / mkhan po dag gos dag 'tshem pa na lhan cig gnas pa dang /nye gnas dag snying las 7chung ngur 'khod nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag gis khab blang zhing /slob dpon dang / mkhan po dag snying las chung ngur bya'o/ / tshem 'drub nipar bskos na ni ltung ba med do/ /lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag gis slob dpon dang / mkhan po dag gi 0lung mnos te de dag nyid kyi mdun na klog ⑨ nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑩bka' stsal pa/ dge slong kha ton slob pa phyedag gis lung mnos nas spre)thos pa'i nyen kor 8spangs te snang ba'i nye ⑫7—38

'khor du 'dug nas lung phog la bklag dzipar bya'o/ /dge slong spong ba pa ②dag gis gdams ngag mnos nas mtha' gcig tu song ste yid la bya ba bskyed par bya'o/ /lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas de dag las su bskos par 'gro ba na ①de dag slob dpon dang / mkhan po dag la zhus te song ba na/der song ba de dag la las gzhan byung nas de dag yang phyir 'ong zhing bzhu bar byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te der dong ༷ba rnams la ༅las gzhan byung na de dag gis yang dang yang du phyir 'ongs ⑦te zhu bar mi bya bar de nyid du las bya stesri/ de dag girme sngar zhus pa de nyid kyis thams cad zhus pa yin no/ /de dag gis der stan dag khyer ba phyir khyer te mi 'ong ⑨nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gis stan khyer te 'ong bar bya'o//de dag gis ches sngar stan dag khyer te dong ba dang / slob dpon dang /mkhan po dag la gang gis de dag mi 'gro ba de 'dra ba'i rkyen byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag gis slob dpon dang mkhan po dag la 'chag tu 'gro ⑩'am mi 'gro zhes zhu bar bya zhing gal te 'gro'o zhes zer na stan dag bskur ⑩bar bya'o/ /gal te mi 8'gro zhes zer na stan dag bskur tsobar mi bya'o/ /khyim bdag gcig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa ④dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du bshos tsol spyan drangs pa na/ gzhon nu zhig dge ba'i phyogs la shin tu brtson nas des bsams pa/ deng skyabadag bsod snyoms la 'jug ⑩mi dgos pas ji srid du gdugs tshod la bab par ma gyur pa de srid kyi bar du dge ba'i phyogs la tron tsobya'o snyam nas/ de stan khyer te phyi rol du song ba dang / dge slong rnams dus snga ma tshogs tsos gtsug lag khang gi sgo bcad de 7—39

dong ngo / /des kyang dus shes par byas te 'ongs pa dang / ji tsam na ①gtsug lag khang gi sgo bcad pa mthong nas des bsams rāpa/ bdag zan bcad pa ni bla'i bdag ltung ba dang bcas na mi rung ngo snyam nas de ②zan bcad pa byas pa dang / de'i lus la ji srid du mdangs ④yod pa de srid du des dge ba'i phyogs la tron 0byas so/ /gang gi tshe lus las nyamadangs yal ⑦ba de'i tshe na glos phab ste nyal ba dang / dge slong rnams kyis de la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gal te zan gzhan gyi yin zhes te lto yang gzhan gyi ⑧yin snyam mamal/ci na khyed ci ⑨ tsam gyis dge ba'i phyogs la tron byed kyang ⑩mi nus pa de tsam ⑫za'am / sus zos/ khyod kyis ma zos sam/ ma zos so/ /ci'i phyir/des 'askabs de dge slong rnams la brjod nas/ dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams kyis dus snga ma tshogs ④su khyim gzhan du 'jug par mi bya bar dus ⑫shes par byas te gaṇḍi brdungs nas 'jug par bya'o/ /slob dpon dang /mkhan po dag gis kyang rang rang 0gi 'khor la blta bar bya'o/ /blo 0bur du 'ongs pa 'ga' zhig yod na de ni dge 'dun gyi tsoganas brtan gyis ⑩blta bar bya'o / /gal te dge slong sgo bcad ⑥ par 'ongs na des stan de rtsig 0pa'i drung ngam shing ljon pa'i drung du bzhag ⑤ste 'gro bar bya'o/ /dge slong gis gya tshom du zan gcad phyopar mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis gya tshom du zan gcod par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gtsug lag khang du 'ongs te/ de dag stan dag la 'dug 'dug nas de nyid du bor te rdzidong nasabya/ de dag sus kyang ma brubs 0pas de nyid du ma shyi7wa 40

rung bar gyur nas/4 bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gis mthong ba des brub par bya'o/ /dge slong rgan po 'khogs pa nyam chung ba dang /nad pa sbyor mi bzod pa dag gis de dag bla gab med par bzhag pa mthong zhing de dag gis 'brub ①par mi nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de dag gis dge skos ②la brjod par bya zhing / des kyang gus par bya ste brub ②par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis gnas mal dag bla gab med par bting rjonas dge slong gcig pu zhig la bcol nas bsod snyoms la zhugs shing gzhan gyis kyang de nyid la bcoladu/ gzhan gyis kyang de nyid la bcol te bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / rlung dang char byung ste des brub par ma ⑥nus nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab tu mang po dag gis dge slong gcig la bcol bar mi bya'o/ /gal te de lta bu'i rkyen byung na des gaṇḍi brdung ⑦bar bya zhing de na dge slong gang dag 'khod pa de dag gis gus par bya ste brub par bya'o/ /de dag gis kyang chagaṇḍi thos nas gus pas 'gro bar bya'o/ /nags kyi nang na gtsug lag khang 'dug pa la me shor nas mes 0grong dang tho)/grong khyer dang / rgyal po'i pho brang dang / yul 'khor yang tshig la thug /spyod yul dang spyod yul gyi lam dang / 'chag sa dang / dag tshur dang / sgo khang tsodang / gtsug lag khang yang 'tshig la thug pa na/ dge slong rnams kyis rang rang gi lhung bzed dang chos gos dag ni phyung / dge 'dun gyi gnas mal dag ni tshig nas khyim bdag 'ongs te dge slong rnams la dris pa/ 'phags pa dag ci dag ma tshig gam/ ci yang ma tshig go/ /dge 'dun gyi ciganas mal dag ga re/ tshig go/ /ci 8yang ma tshig pa de/ de 'dra'am/ kho bo cag 7—41

gi ci yang ma tshig go/ /des smras pa/ kye ma'o dge 'dun gyi ①gnas mal tsam 'byin kyang ma phod ces zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi gnas mal yang dbyung bar bya'o/ /de dag dge 'dun gyi gnas mal 'byin pa na de dag gi ②gang zag gi gnas mal dang / lhung bzed dang /chos gos dag tshig nas/ de dag phongs par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang zag ni phongs par 'gyur ②la/ dge 'dun ni mi ④'gyur bas je dang por ⑤gang zag gi 0lhung bzed dang / chos gos dbyung bar bya zhing de'i 'og tu dge 'dun gyi dbyung bar bya'o/ /de dag phyung ba na ma byin pa ⑦len pa dag gis brkus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ der srung nim dge slong gzhag par bya'o/ /de dag mthu dang ldan pa ⑨'jog par byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mthu chung ngu gzhag par bya'o / /de dag me mi bzod par 'jug par byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te me mi bzod pa yin na 'jug par mi bya ste/gal te tshig na yang de la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /ser che ba'i dbus na gtsug lag khang 'dug ⑨ cing / steng gi ri kha nas char pa'i rgyun sbom po bab pa na/gtsug lag khang du chu byung zhing grong yidang / grong khyer dang / rgyal po'i pho brang dang / yul 'khor yang khyer la thug /spyod yul dang spyod ⑤yul gyi lam dang / dag tsor dang / sgo khang dang ⑫/ gtsug lag khang yang khyer la thug pa na/ dge slong rnams kyis rang rang gi lhung bzed dang chos gos dag ni phyung /7—42

dge 'dun gyi gnas mal dag ni khyer nas/ khyim bdag 'ongs nas dge slong rnams la dris pa/ 'phags pa dag ci dag ma khyer ram/ ci yang ma khyer ro/ /dge 'dun gyi gnas mal dag ga ①re/ khyer ro/ /ci yang ma khyer ba de de 'dra'am / kho bo cag gi ci yang ma khyer ro/ /des smras pa/ kye ma'o dge 'dun gyi ②gnas mal tsam 'byin kyang ma phod ①ces zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi gnas mal yang dbyung bar bya'o/ /de dag dge 'dun gyi gnas mal 'byin pa na de dag gi ④gang zag gi gnas mal dang /lhung bzed dang / chos gos dag khyer nas de dag phongs par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang zag ni phongs par 'gyur ⑤la/ dge 'dun ni mi 'gyur bas je dang por gang zag gi lhung bzed dang / chos gos dbyung bar bya zhing / de'i 'og tu yidage 'dun gyi dbyung bar bya'o/ /de dag phyung ba na ma byin par len pa dag gis brkus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ der srung ⑦ma dge slong gzhag par bya'o/ /de dag mthu dang ldan pa 'jog par byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mthu chung ngu gzhag par bya'o/ /de dag chu mi bzod ⑤par 'jug par byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te chu mi bzod pa yin na 'jug par mi bya ste/ gal te khyer na yang de la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /las dang po pa dang /smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /gnas mal gyi ltung byed de bcu bzhi pa rdzogs sto// //7—43

bar sdom la①/ lho lam dang ni ma bor dang / /ma dris 'dor dang mthus 'dor rgyadang / /khron pa dang ni blang ba ②dang / /dag ④ra dang ni 'chag ⑤sa dang / /lci ba gzhag pa tha ma yin/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /lho lam nas dge slong rgan pa dang / gzhon pa gnyis shig bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs la phyag 'tshal du mnyan yod du 'ongs nas/ rgan ⑦shos kyi ⑧gtsug lag khang ni gnas mal dang bcas pa zhig tu bskos/ gzhon pa shos kyi gtsug lag khang ni gnas mal med pa zhig tu bskos pa dang / gzhon pa shos de sgrub phod pa zhig yin pas des rtswa mang po dag blangs nas pus mo nub tsam gyi gding ba bshams so/ /rgan pa des bsams pa/ gzhon nu de'i gtsug lag khang ji lta bu zhig tu bskos pa je bltas 'gro'o snyam nas de der song ba dang / ji tsam na gding ba bzang po bshams pa mthong nas des bsams pa/bdag ji srid du gnas mal phyir gtod par byed pa de srid du sang 'gro ba 'phyis bar 'gyur gyis ⑨'di nyid du 'dug go snyam nas/ des gnas mal dang bcas pa'i gtsug lag khang de dge slong gnas mal 'bog tho )pa la phyir gtad nas/de gnyis gtsug lag khang der ⑩mtshan mo gnas nas nang par sngar langs te dong ngo / /phyogs de sa 8snum zhing dngar tsob yin pas rtswa bting ba dag la sril dag chags ④nas gtsug lag khang de'i phyi nang bcas pa thams cad sril 8gyis khyab par gyur to/ /de'i tshe na khyim bdag gcig 8gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun 0khyim gzhan du gdugs tsotshod la spyan drangs pa da nga /7—44

dge slong gi dge 'dun ni bzhugs ①so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par bsgrubs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu lngas rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par bsgrub par ②mdzad de/ lnga gang zhe na/ nang du yang dag 'jog bzhed pa dang / lha rnams la chos ston par bzhed pa dang / nad pa la lta bar bzhed pa dang / gnas mal la rtog ②par bzhed pa dang / 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ④bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' bar bzhed pa'o/ /don 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das gnas mal la rtog par bzhed pa dang / 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' bar bzhed pas rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par bsgrub pa ⑤mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun song nas ring po ma lon par thugs su chud nas lde mig bsnams te kun dga'i yir ba nas kun dga'i ra bar gtsug lag khang nas gtsug lag khang du/ khang khyim nas khang khyim du༅/ 'chag sa nas 'chag lasar dang / gol bar gshegs shing mthar gyis gshegs ⑨pa na/gtsug lag khang de ga la ba der gshegs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gtsug lag khang de sril ⑩dag gis phyi nang 7thams cad khyab par gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang e ma zhes gsungs shing tsomad nas 'di snyam du dgongs te/bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis pags 8pa dang / sha dang /khrag dag bcir cing bcir cing ⑩sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams tsodag byed pa gang yin pa de la dge slong dag drod mi shes pa dang / so sor mi rtog par yongs su longs spyod do snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di 7—45

snyam du dgongs te/ bdag gis ci nas kyang sril ①dag logs shig tu 'gyur zhing / sa dag kyang logs shig tu 'gyur ba ②de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du bya'o snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ci nas kyang sril chadag kyang logs shig tu 'gyur zhing sa dag kyang logs shig tu 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du mdzad dol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor lo dang / bkra shis dang /g.yung drung gi ④lhags kyu ⑤dag dang ldan pa'i phyag dra bar ⑥'brel pa/ bsod nams brgya phrag du ma las 'khrungs pa gnyis kyis sril ⑦de dag legs par bsdus te bsil ⑧ba'i phyogs su gzhag ⑨pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gtsug lag khang de chag chag btab ste phyag dar mdzad nas nyal nyil gtsug lag khang gi ⑨ phyi rol du bor te phyag dang zhabs gnyis bsil nas nang du yang dag 'jog gi slad du gtsug lag khang du gshegs so/ /de nas dge slong bsod snyoms sgrub 7pas bsod snyoms blangs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos nyid kyis bsod snyoms ④sgrub pa'i dge slong la dge slong ji lta zas bsod dam/ dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par byas sam zhes so sor kun dga' bar ⑫ mdzad pa 'dis so sor kun dga' bar ④mdzad pa yin pas bcom ldan 'das 8kyis dge slong bsod snyoms sgrub pa la dge slong ji lta zas bsod dam/ dge slong gi ⑩dge 'dun tshim par byas sam zhes so sor kun dga' bar mdzad pa dang / des gsol pa/ btsun pa zas te por bsod cing dge slong gi tshudage 'dun tshim par bgyis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das zhal zas kyi 8bya ba mdzad nas/ gtsug lag khang gi slad rol du 7—46

zhabs gnyis bsil te/ nang du yang dag 'jog gi ⑨slad du gtsug lag khang du gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyi dro nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams ②pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams chal bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di na ngas dge slong gi dge 'dun song nas ④ring po ma lon par shes nas lde mig khyer te kun dga'i ra ba nas kun dga'i ra ⑤bar/gtsug ༅lag khang nas gtsug ⑦lag khang du/ khang khyim nas khang khyim du/'chag sa nas 'chag sar dang / gol bar song shing ⑤mthar gyis 'gro ba na gtsug lag khang zhig ga la ba der phyin nas ngas gtsug lag khang de sril ⑨dag gis phyi nang thams 7cad khyab ⑨par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang / e ma'o ⑫zhes byas te smad nas 'di snyam du bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis pags ⑩pa dang / sha dang / khrag dag bcir ④cing bcir cing sbyin pa dag sbyin tsobasod nams dag byed pa gang yin pa de la dge slong dag drod mi shes pa dang / so sor mi rtog par yongs su longs spyod do 8snyam du dgongs kyisabya/dge slong dag khyed kyis dad pas sbyin par bya ba la drod ran par yongs su longs spyad pa dang / spang zhing yongs su longs spyad pa dang / dus su yongs su longs spyad pa dang / brtag 8cing yongs su longs spyad pa dang / khad kyis yongs su longs spyad na legs so// //bar sdom la/ drod ran pa dang spang ba dang / /de bzhin dus dang brtag pa dang / /khad kyis ⑩yongs su spyad pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drod ran pa dang / spang ba dang / dus dang / brtag pa dang /7—47

khad kyis yongs su longs spyod pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ①de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang ②dge ③'dun gyi gtsug lag khang du rtswa'i gding ba'am/ lo ma'i gding ba bting ④ngam/'ding du bcug nas ma bsdus sam sdud du ma bcug par de nas song na ltung byed do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi rjobaslab pa'i gzhi de ltar bca' ba ⑥mdzad do/ /dge slong rab tu mang po dag don mthun dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur 'dong ⑦ba na ri brags shig tu phyin nas/ de na de dag khyim bdag gi gan du song ste/ khyim bdag kho bo cag la gnas g.yor cig ces gnas brnyas pa dang / khyim bdag gis smras pa/ dam tshig gis g.yar bar bgyi ste/ gal te bdag gi ⑧bsod snyoms gsol te gshegs na g.yar ro/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag kho bo cag ni don mthun la rag las pa yin pas/ gal te don mthun sdod na bza' bar bya'o/ /khyim bdag 'di na khri'am/ khri'u lta ⑨yod dam/ 'phags pa dag ma mchis so/ /dge slong de dag la khyim pa dang / dge tshul mang du yod pas de dag gis rtswa ⑨ mang po blangs te pus mo nub tsam gyi ⑩gding ba bshams tsoso/ /don mthun nam ma nangs pa nyid du 'phags nas/ dge slong de dag gis kyang gding ba ma bor bar dong ngo / /khyim bdag gis bsams paX/ gal te 'phags pa dag ⑫bzhugs na de dag gi tsogadugs tshod sta gon byas je tshubalta'o snyam nas de song ba 7—48

dang / ji tsam na dge slong de dag nam ma nangs pa kho nar dong ba mthong ngo / /khyim bdag de chung ma dang bcas pas gding ba de dag 'dor ba na snga dro ril gyis yol bar gyer to/ /dge slong rab tu mang po gzhan dag don mthun dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur ①dong ba na ②ri brags de nyid du phyin nas/ de na de dag khyim bdag gi ②gan du song ste khyim bdag kho bo cag la gnas g.yor ducig ces gnas brnyas pa dang / khyim bdag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag rjodam tshig gis g.yar bar bgyi ste/ gal te khyed cag ran gyi gding ba mi 'ding dun g.yar bar bgyi'o/ /khyim bdag 'di na gang du kho bo cag nyal bar bya ba'i khri'am / khri'u lta yod dam/ 'phags pa dag ma mchis so/ /khyim bdag sa sgre bo la ji ltar nyal bar bya/ 'phags pa dag khyed cag nyid kyi ༷tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag lhags par gyur nas/ de dag gis ran gyi dugading ba bting ⑨na sa ma bor bar dong nas bdag mchis 'brang ⑨ dang bcas pa de 'dor ba na snga dro ril gyis yol bar gyur to/ /dge slong de dag sa sgre bo tshul mtshan mo 'da' bar tsobyas nas nang par sngar langs te dong ngo ⑫/ /de dag mthar gyis rgyu zhing dong ba na mnyan yod du phyin nas/ dge slong rnams kyis de dag mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'ongs pa legs so 'ongs pa legs so/ /ji lta ④bde bar brgyus sam/ ji ltar tsobade ba tshubargyus/ sa sgre bo la mtshan thog thag ⑩'gre ldog pas 'da' ba byas so/ /khyod 8cag ri brags gang du zhag⑩ /ga ge mo zhig tu'o/ /khyim bdag gang gi dusdum par/ che ge mo zhig gi'o/ /de na dge slong kha cig gis smras pa/ kho bo cag ni khyim bdag de'i sdum par gding ba la nyal te 'ongs so/ /khyod 0cag gis gding ba de gang 7—49

du bor/ de nyid du bor ro/ /de'i phyir khyim bdag de smod ①par byed do ②zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim gzhan nas ①kyang gding ba dor bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim gzhan nas kyang gding ba dor bar bya'o//zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong rab tu mang po dag don mthun dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur 'dong ba na ri brags ④shig tu phyin to/ /ri brags de na khyim bdag cig gis dge sbyong dang ⑤/ bram ze blo ༅bur du lhags pa rnams kyi don du thag ring po nas rtswa mang po dag blangs te gding ba bshams so/ /dge slong de dag khyim bdag de'i gan du song ste/ khyim bdag kho bo cag la gnas g.yor cig ces gnas brnyas pa dang / khyim bdag des ⑦smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bdag gis dge sbyong dang / bram ze blo ③bur du lhags pa rnams kyi don du thag ring po nas rtswa mang po 0blangs te gding ba ⑩'di bshams kyis ⑩'dir gzims shig /de dag der nyal nas nam ma nangs pa kho nar khyim bdag la ma dris par gding ba bor te dong ngo / /khyim bdag tsode nang par sngar langs nas/ de bor te dong ba mthong nas khyim bdag des bsams pa/ ltar tso'agro'o/ /gal te phyogs gtsang mar bor bar gyur na yang blang ngo / /snyam nas de ltar song ba dang / ji tsam na phyogs mi gtsang bar bor ba mthong nas ④des de ma blangs so//dge slong rab tu mang po gzhan dag don mthun dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur 'dong ba na ri brags 8de nyid du phyin nas/ de dag khyim bdag de'i gan du song ste/khyim bdag kho bo cag la gnas g.yor cig ces gnas brnyas pa dang / khyim bdag des smras tshupa/ 'phags pa dag bzhugs 0su gsol/ khyim bdag 'di 7450

na khri'am/ khri'u dag yod dam/ 'phags pa dag ma mchis so/ /khyim bdag sa sgre ①bo 'di la ji ltar nyal bar bya/ 'phags pa dag bdag gis dge sbyong ②dang bram ze blo ①bur du lhags rjopa rnams kyi dudon du thag ring po nas rtswa rjo mang po blangs te gding ba bshams par gyur pa las/ khyed cag nyid kyi ⑦tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag lhags ⑤par gyur te⑨/ de dag der nyal nas nam ma nangs pa kho nar bdag la ma dris par gding ba de dag phyogs ⑩mi gtsang bar bor te ⑩dong ngo / /de dag der sa sgre bo la nyal te dong ngo / /de dag mthar gyis rgyu zhing 'dong ba na mnyan yod du phyin nas/ dge slong rnams kyis de dag mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'ongs pa legs so/ /'ongs pa legs so/ /ji lta 8bde bar brgyus sam/ de dag gis smras pa/ji ltar bde bar brgyus(sme/ sa sgre bo (srel mtshan thog thag 'gres ldog ste(sme/nam nangs so/ /khyed cag ri brags gang du zhag⑩ /ga ge mo zhig tu'o/ /khyim bdag gang gi 0sdum par/ che ge mo zhig gi'o/ /de na tsodage slong kha cig gis smras pa/ kho bo cag ni khyim bdag de'i sdum par gding ba la nyal te 'ongs sol/ / khyed cag gis chagading ba de gar bzhag ༷ /phyi rol du bor ro/ /de'i phyir khyim bdag de smod do zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/khyim bdag 'dug pa la dri bar bya ste/ gal te 'or cig ces zer na dor bar bya'o / /gal te ma dor cig 0ces zer na dor bar mi bya'o/ /ri brags shig na gtsug dulag khang gnas mal med pa zhig yod pa der/ dge slong rnams kyis dge slong blo dubur du lhags pa rnams kyi rdzidon du thag ring po nas rtswa mang po 7—51
