cig /yang na 'di'i brla g.yas pas gser ji ①tsam 'dren nus pa de tsam byin cig ces brjod par bya'o/ /phyi de nyin bar de dag 'ongs te lardza mkhan la dris pa/ kwa'i chanang rje khyod ༷kyis gros byas sam/ gros byas so/ /'o na rte'u 'di byin cig khyed ①rta cang shes zhes zer du ngo tsha'am ci/ de dag gis bsams pa/ glen pa 'dis 'di rta cang shes yin nam ma yin ci shes te/'di ltar rta 'di nyid byas pa gzo dub yin pas 'di nyid kyis ⑦'di la smras par gyur gor ma chag snyam nas de dag gis smras pa/ rta cang shes yin yang rung /rte'u yin yang rung gis ③rin gyi ①phyir byin cig /rdza mkhan gyis ⑩smras pa/yang na gser 'bum byin cig /yang na 'di'i brla yigayas pas gser ji tsam 'dren nus pa de tsam byin cig /de dag gis bsams 8pa/ 'di mthu dang ldan pa yin 8pas chos byamang po dag 'dren par 'gyur ba gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 'gyur ro snyam nas smras pa/ gser 'bum sbyin no/ /de dag gis 8rgyal po tshangs sbyin tshul gser 'bum gyis rta cang shes khugs so zhes spring pa dang / rgyal po tshangs pas byin ⑦gyis de dag la rin ji 8tsam gyis khug ⑩pa de tsam gyis long shig ⑩ces spring ngo / /de dag gis gser 'bum gyis blangs nas de dag rta cang shes de khrid de bā rā ṇa sīr 0lhags nas de dag gis de 3rta bres kyi dang por btags 0te de la rtswa dang chas byin na de 3de mi za nas rgyal pos smras pa/ khyed kyi blarta cang shes nad pa zhig khrid de 'ongs sam ci de dag gis smras pa/ 'di bro 'tshal ba ma lags te/ 'di ltar je tso'adi la rma'o ⑦zhes de nas 'dul sbyong bas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ mgyogs 'gro gang tshe ran chas chu med pa'i/ /rdza mkhan bres na mgo skams tsorus lpags tsam / /7—202

rang sos gtubs pa'i rtsa ①dag za ba soms/ /de latshe mang pos khyod la bsams ma gyur/ /'di na mgyogs 'gro ②stong gi thog 'dren cing / /rgyal pos chibs ran mchog dag nyer bstabs pa/ /ci'i phyir mi za dris pa bdag la smros/ /de nas rab mgyogs drang po brtan ldan pa/ /mi rjobazod 'khrugs bcas rjomagyogs 'gro mchog gis ni/ /de las nyer zhi 0legs par bsams ②byas nas//'dul sbyong blo ldan mi mchog de la smras/ /'dir khyod kho bo'i g.yon tan de nyid shes / /kho bo ji bzhin khyod 0kyis ma rig ⑩min/ /mkhas pas brnyas na sa steng mi rgyu zhing / /kho bo 'dir ⑩ni 8myur du shi yang bla/ /skye bo ngan pas yun ring brnyas gyur kyang / /gal te yon tan khyod ldan de brnyas min/ /skye bo mdzangs 8pas skad cig brnyas gyur na/ /zhi ba gal te yon tan de brnyas yin//'dul sbyong ④bas rgyal po la smras pa/ lha 'di ni bro 'tshal ba ma lags kyi 'di ltar rim pa ma bgyis pas de'i slad du 'di ran dang chas 8mi 'tshal lo/ /'di'i rim ⑩pa ji ltar bya/ lha shul dpag tshad phyed ⑩dang gsum tshun chad ⑫mdzes par bgyi zhing grong khyer yang mdzes par bgyi/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bor dbang bskur ba dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas pas bsu ⑩bar bgyi / phyogs gang du bzhag ⑥pa'i phyogs de zangs ma'i glegs bu dag gis g.yog par bgyi/ rgyal po'i sras bu thu bos mgo'i steng du gdugs srog ⑥shing brgya pa gzung bar bgyi/ rgyal po'i sras mo thu mos rnga yab gser can nor bus spras pas sbrang ma dag dubaskyab par bgyi/ rgyal po'i btsun mo dam pas gser gyi snod nas zil dngar gyis dubacin ④pa'i bzang chas kyi zas bstabs dupar bgyi/rgyal po'i blon po dam pas gser gyi chol chazangs kyis rtug pa dor bar bgyi'o/ /7—203

rgyal pos smras pa/ de lta na 'di ①rgyal po yin gyi nga rgyal po ma yin no/ /'dul sbyong bas ②smras pa/ lha 'di la dus thams cad du bsnyen bkur de ltar bgyi mi ①'tshal te/ 'di ltar dgung bdun gyi bar du bgyi'o/ /dgung bdun 'das nas bka' nyan par 'gyur roX/ /'das ⑤pa gang lags pa de da dubagyi bar mi spyod kyang lhag ma gang lags ⑦pa de mdzad du gsol/ rgyal pos phyogs ⑧gang du gzhag ⑨pa'i phyogs de zangs ma'i glegs bu dag gis kyang g.yogs/rgyal po'i bu thu bo yang mgo'i steng du gdugs srog shing brgya pa 'dzin du bcug /rgyal po'i bu mo thu mo yang rnga yab gser can nor bus spras pas sbrang ma dag skyob tu bcug⑩ /rgyal po'i btsun mo dam pa yang gser gyi snod nas zil dngar 7gyis bcin 8pa'i bzang chas kyi 0zas stobs su bcug /rgyal po'i blon po dam pa yang tsogaser gyi chol byazangs kyis 8rtag pa 'dor du bcug go/ /sa bdag 'dul sbyong bcas pa de la chags/ /shin tu dri zhim byug pa mchog 'chang zhing / /sa bdag btsun mo zil dngar ⑩bzang chas kyis/ /snod bkang tsomagyogs 'gro mchog phyir 'dzin par byed/ rgyal po skyed yimos tshal gyi sar 'gro bar 'dod pa la rta cang shes phul ba dang / des rgyab smad nas rgyal pos 'dul sbyong ba la rmas ⑥pa/ 'di rgyab mi na'am/ des smras pa/ lha bro mi ⑥'tshal te/ 'di ltar rgyal po bcibs dka' bar 'gyur dusnyam nas 0de'i slad du tso'adis rgyab smad do/ /rgyal pos duzhon te song ba dang / de 'gro ba na chu byung nas de de la mi rgal ba dang / rgyal pos 'dul sbyong ba la rmas 0pa/ 'di mi 'jigs sam/lha mi 'jigs te 'di ltar rnga ma'i chab kyis rgyal po gsher bar gyur na 0mi rung ngo snyam pas de'i slad du rgal bar mi bgyid do/ /rgyal pos de'i rnga ma gser gyi 7—204

sbubs su bcug pa dang de de las rgal to/ /rgyal po de skyed ①mos tshal du song ste bag med par ②'dug pa dang / nyi rgya'og gi rgyal po dag gis rgyal po tshangs byin skyed 0mos tshal du song ngo zhes thos nas/ de dag lhags nas grong khyer gyi sgo dag bzung ①ngo / /rgyal po tshangs byin gyis nyi du'og gi rgyal po dag gis grong khyer gyi sgo dag bzung ngo zhes thos nas de rta cang shes la zhon pa dang / bā rā ṇa sī dang skyed ⑦mos tshal gyi bar du rdzing bu tshangs ldan zhes bya ba utpal dudang /pad ma dang / ku mu da ⑨dang / pad ma dkar pos khebs pa zhig gis chod nas 0rta cang shes kyis bsams ⑩pa/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bor dbang bskur bske/ gnod pa dang / nyam chang ba dang / phongs par gyur pa bdag gis yal bar dor ba ni 0bdag gi tshul dang mthun pa ma yin no snyam nas/ rta cang shes des pad ma'i 'dab tsom dag gi steng du rkang pa bzhag ste sge'u cung tsonas bā rā ṇa sīr (9zhugs pa dang / rgyal po dga' nas blon po rnams la smras pa/shes ldan dag gang gis ⑩rgyal po rgyal rigs tsospyi bor dbang bskur ba'i srog phyung ba de la ci sbyin/ lha rgyal srid kyi phyed do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'di ni dud 'gro yin pas 'di la rgyal srid kyi phyed kyis ci bya ste/ 'di ltar 'di las rten ⑥te zhag bdun du sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag bya zhing dus ma yin par ku mu da'i dus ston bya'o snyam nas/ rgyal po ⑥de las rten te 0zhag bdun du sbyin pa dag sbyin pa dang / bsod nams dag bya bar brtsams ⑥shing zhag bdun du dus ma yin par duku mu da'i dus ston dag byas pa dang / ded dpon des mi dag la dris pa/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir dus ma yin par ku mu da'i dus ston 'di byung bar gyur/ de dag gis de la smras chapa/ rgyal pos mchod 7—205

gyur ces bya ba'i gnas de nas rdza mkhan ①zhig las gser 'bum gyis rta cang shes nyos te 'dir 'ongs nas des rgyal po 'di'i srog phyung nas/ rgyal pos ②de las rten ③te zhag bdun du sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag byed cing dus ma yin par ku mu da'i dus ston byas so/ /ded dpon gyis bsams 0pa/ma la rte'u de cang shes su ma gyur tam duje song la de blta'o snyam nas rjode'i gan du song ba dang / rta cang shes des smras pa/ kwa'i ⑦nang rje khyod kyis rta lnga brgya po dag gis ci thob/ gser 'bum mo/ /kho ⑧bo gcig 0pus kyang rdza mkhan de la gser 'bum byin no/ /de brgyal te sa la 'gyel nas chu gdab ⑩pas srog phyir rnyed nas rta cang shes kyi rkang pa gnyis la gtugs 7te bzod pa gsol to/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na ded dpon gang yin pa de ni 'tsho byed gzhon nus gsos 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na rta cang shes gang yin pa de ni lam pa 'di nyid yin te/ de'i tshe yang des gang gi tshe de'i yon tan dag mngon par mi shes pa de'i tshe na de la gus pa ma yin pa la zhugs par gyur la/ gang gi tshe de'i yon tan dag mngon par shes par gyur pa de'i tshe na rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te bzod pa gsol bar gyur la8/ da ltar yang des gang gi tshe 'di'i yon tan dag mngon par mi shes pa de'i tshe na 'di la gus pa ma yin pa la zhugs la/ gang gi tsotshe yon tan dag mngon par shes par gyur pa de'i tshe tson rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te bzod pa gsol bar byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa lam pas las ci bgyis tson las de'i rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis sems sgyur ba la mkhas pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan/ bcom 7—206

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smon lam gyi dbang gis so/ /gang du smon lam btab/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la 'di ①rab tu byung bar gyur pa na gang las rab tu byung ②ba'i mkhan po de yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis sems sgyur ba la mkhas pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan to①/ /de na 'dis 0tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang ma thob nas de'i 'og tu 'chi ba'i tshe smon lam 'di skad ces bdag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa ⑤yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan rjobla na med pa 'od srung la tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang ma thob ste/ bdag gis tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa ⑦yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis ⑤bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la ⑨bram ze'i khye'u khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig ⑩pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i ⑩kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi 8ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de'i bstan pa la bdag rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon 'du byed cing ji ltar mkhan po 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa ④yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis sems sgyur ba la mkhas pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de bzhin du bdag 7—207

kyang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa shākya'i seng ge shākya'i rgyal po'i gtso bo des sems sgyur ①ba la mkhas pa rnams kyi ②mchog tu bstan par gyur cig ces gdab par brtsams ②pas smon lam de'i dbang gis rjod ltar de bzhin gshegs pas ⑤sems sgyur ba la mkhas pa rnams kyi ༷mchog tu bstan to/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni ⑦gcig tu gnag pa yin la/ las gcig tu dkar ba ⑧rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu dkar ba yin/ las 'dren ma rnams kyi ⑨rnam par smin pa yang 'dren ma yin no / /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa dang / 'dren ma rnams spangs te/ las gcig tu dkar ba ⑩rnams la brtsal yibar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos ⑩pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la nyung ba med do/ /ma bskos par ston pa'i lhung byed de nyi shu gcig pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' byed khyod kyis tsodage slong ma la 'doms ④shig /dga' byed khyod kyis dge slong ma la rjes su ston cig /dga' byed khyod kyis dge slong ma rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis shig ces bka' stsal nas/ de nas utpala'i mdog 'khor dge slong ma lnga brgya tsotshe dang ldan pa dga' byed ga la ba der song ste/ phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed kyi rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te tsomatha' gcig du 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed kyis bsams pa/7—208

bud med kyi ①yul ni shes rab chung ba yin no snyam nas des de la don dang /tshig dang / yi ge mdor ②'dus pa 'dus pa dag gis chos bstan to/ /de shes rab can yin pas gong nas gong du 'dri bar byed nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed kyis lan btab cing / des de la ji tsam na nyi ma nub pa'i dus la bab pa de tsam gyi bar du chos bstan nas de dag gis de'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te stan las langs te dong ba dang / ji tsam na mnyan yod kyi sgo dag bcad par gyur nas dge slong ma rnams kyis sgo btsal ba dang / sgo bas smras pa/sgo bcad lags so/ /de dag gis ②smras pa/ phye shig lde mig dag rgyal po'i pho brang du 'tshal to/ /de dag gis bsams pa/ 'di nyid du 'khod do snyam nas mnyan yod dang ha cang mi ring ba na kun dga' ra ba zhig 'dug pa der de dag dong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis shing ljon pa yang rgan rims kyis bsko bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pas de dag gis shing ljon pa dag rgan rims kyis bsko bar brtsams ༷pa dang / de na de dag shing 0ljon pa dag sgo ⑥ba rnams la a yī ⑦a yu ha ḍi ③a ga e a ga ha ḍi ⑨zhes 'bod pa'i sgra mthon po dang / sgra chen po byung ngo / /g.yon can lnga brgya tsam mnyan yod 'joms tshupar 'dod pa dag 7lhags pa de dag gis sgra mthon po dang / sgra chen po de 8thos nas/ de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag mnyan yod na tsore zhig sdod cig /shes ldan dag rje ⑫btsun mo'i 'khor gyis ma tsothos par tso'adi dag gzhom par bya'o/ /utpa la'i mdog gis bsams pa/ mi mdzes pa 'ga' zhig 0rig 8par mi 'gyur ram snyam na/ ji tsam na yi'ajoms 0par 'dod pa'i g.yon can lnga brgya tsam po de dag mthong nas des 'phags skyes po'i dpung sprul te rnga pa ṭa ha ⑥brdungs pa 7—209

dang / de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag 'phags skyes po'i dpung gis bskor te bdag cag zin par gyur na mi rung gis ①'bros par bya'o zhes de ltar rig nas de dag bros so/ /utpa la'i mdog gis dge slong ma de dag la smras pa/ phu ②nu mo dag g.yon can 'joms ③par 'dod pa lnga brgya tsam 'dir lhags nas kho mos de dag bsdigs nas bros kyisaX/ khad kyi ⑤dal bu dal ①bus lag brdas ④sgo phye ⑧shig /de dag nang par sngar langs te mnyan yod du zhugs pa dang / bram ze ⑨dang / khyim bdag gis mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams kyis 0chos 'dre yib dang /lhag ⑩par 'dre zhing 'tshangs par spyad pa spyod par byed pa bzang ngo / /dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i ④phyir dge slong dag nyi ma nub pa'i dus kyi bar du dge slong ma la ston par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang gleng gzhi 'di dang skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ⑩ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed la mas ⑩pa/ dga' byed khyod 0nyi ma nub pa'i dus kyi bar du dge slong ma la ston pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi brtson pa dang mi sbyor ba dang / ma tsobartags par spyod pa rnam par smad pa ⑩mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis brtson pa dang / sbyor ba dang brtags te spyod pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas/7—210

dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong dge 'dun gyis bskos kyang nyi ma nub pa'i dus kyi bar du dge slong ma la ston na ltung byed do/ /dge slong zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o①/ /dge 'dun gyis zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyis so/ /bskos kyang zhes bya ba ni gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis so/ /nyi ma nub pa'i dus kyi bar du zhes bya ba ni nyi ma nub pa'i dus la bab par ro/ /dge slong ma ②zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa la'o/ /ston na zhes bya ba ni lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang / lhag pa'i sems dang / lhag pa'i shes rab bo/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang / log par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/ 'tshod par byedagye/ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan 0yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags dun dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/ des na ༅ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ⑦ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gi ⑧nyi ma nub pa la nyi ma nub par 'du shes pas dge slong ma la ston na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi 0nyi ma nub pa la yid gnyis za bas dge slong ma la ston na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis nyi ma ma 0nub pa la nyi ma nub par 0'du shes pas dge slong ma la ston na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi 8nyi ma ma 8nub pa 7—211

la yid gnyis za bas dge slong ma la ston na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /mtshan thog thag chos nyan par gyur pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi ༅sgo drung du ston pa dang / sgo ma bcad par 'dug pa dang / grong khyer gyi nang na gtsug lag khang ngamal/ dbyar khang 'dug pa dang / khyim gzhan du song ste ston pa la ltung ba med do/ las dang po pa dang / smyos ③pa dang / sems 'khrugs rjopa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes ⑤nas the tshom ༷thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas ⑦bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa utpa ⑧la'i mdog gis dge slong ma lnga brgya g.yon can gyi 'jigs ⑨pa las yongs su bskyabs pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar du ma zad de/ 'di ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang 'dis don mthun mang po seng ge'i 'jigs pa las yongs su bskyabs par gyur te de nyon cig dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na ri brags shig na khyim bdag cig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur 0spyod par byed do/ /des chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo kho bo yizang thogs te yul gzhan du 'gro'o/ /chung mas smras pa/ rje'i sras bdag kyang mchi'o/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ lam du khyod kyi g.yog sus 8byed par 'gyur/ khyod 'di nyid du 'dug shig chung mas bdag mi khrid do snyam nas ngu bar brtsams pa dang /zho shas 'tsho ba dag gis khyim bdag la dris pa/ jo bos ci'i slad du 'di ngur 455ske/ khyim bdag gis smras pa/ mi khrid do snyam nas 0so/ /de dag gis smras pa/ ci'i slad du mi bkri/ khyim bdag gis smras pa/ der 'di'i 7—212

g.yog su ①byed par 'gyur/ de dag gis smras pa/ der bdag cag gis 'di'i g.yog bgyi'o/ /khyim bdag des ②de khrid de song nas don mthun de dag ③dgon pa'i lam zhig tu mtshan mo rjobatab pa dang / don mthun de dag lam gyis dub pas nyal nas/ khyim bdag gi duchung ma de 0mel tshe byed doX/ /ji tsam na der seng ge 'ongs dunas des mgal dum thogs te de bsdigs pa dang bros par gyur lanas lhas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ gang phyir bya ba thams cad la/ /skyes pa 'ba' zhig mkhas pa ⑩min/ /de dang de la bud med kyang //zin la mkhas pa nyid du 'gyur⑩/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag gi 8chung ma gang yin pa de ni utpa tsola'i mdog 'di nyid yin la/ de'i tshe de'i dus na don mthun lnga brgya tsogang yin pa de dag ni dge slong ma lnga brgya ⑫'di dag yin te/ de'i tshe ⑩yang 'dis don mthun mang po seng ge'i 'jigs pa las yongs su bskyabs par gyur labya/ da 8ltar yang 'dis dge slong ma lnga brgya g.yon can gyi 'jigs pa las yongs su bskyabs yiso/ /nyi ma nub kyi bar du ston pa'i ltung byed de nyi shu gnyis pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' byed khyod kyis dge slong ma la ⑩thoms ⑥shig dga' byed khyod kyis dge slong ma la rjes su ston cig dga' byed khyod kyis dge slong ma rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis shig ces bka' 455 nas ⑤skye dudagu'i bdag mo chen mo 0gi ta sī 'khor dge slong ma lnga brgya dang tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed ga la ba der song ste 7—213

phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed kyi rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed kyis de la don dang /tshig dang / yi ge zab pa zab pa dag gis chos bstan nyuto/ /bud med kyi yul ni shes rab 'chal pa'i phyir brda mi phrad cing 'jigs pa'i phyir 'dri mi nus so/ /de nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta sbos tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed kyis smras pa la ②mngon par dga' ba dang rjes su yi rang ba byas te tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed kyi rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag ②'tshal nas stan las langs te song nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 0zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas dubacom ldan 'das la skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'phags pa dga' byed kyis dge slong ma rnams la don dang / tshig dang / yi ge zab pa zab pa dag gis chos bstan na / bud med kyi yul ni shes rab 'chal pa'i slad du brda mi mjal 0cing /'jigs pa'i slad du 'dri ba'i rngo mi thog ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sbyin pa ni mi 'jigs pa'i rgyu lags so zhes bka' 455 na/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams ⑦la kun dga' bar 'gyur ba dag bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑧bka' stsal pa/ de lta yin gnong gis 4)dge slong ma (7rnams kyis dge slong rnams la kun dga' bar 'gyur ba dag bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la kun dga' bar 'gyur ba dag bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ de dag gis ji ltar bya ba dag mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bca' ba lnga 7—214

po rtsa ba dang sdong bu dang 'dab ①ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dag dang / bza' ba lnga po ②'bras chan ③dang / duzan dron dang / 'de gu dang /du sha dang / snum khur dag dang / lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / dra ba dang / phor bu dang / shur bu dang / lcag phod dang /shur ⑦bu phre'u ⑦dang / rgya cang dag gis bya'o/ /dge slong ma zhig gis 'o thug khyer te rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba dang drug sde dag gi ⑧kun du spyod pa ni 'dir bdag cag gis bram ze dang / khyim bdag 'ongs shing lhags pa la yang 0chos bstan par bya0/ rgol ba dag kyang tshar gcad 7par bya/ rang gi grags pa yang bsgrag par bya'o snyam nas/ drug sde tsolas gang yang rung bas rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo stong par mi 'jog pas nye dga' nang par sngar langs te so shing bor nas snam sbyar dmar ser gyon te rgyal byed kyi tshal 0gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug go//nye dga'as dge slong ma de mthong nas de la dris pa/ khyer te 'ongs pa 'di ci/'o thug go/ /su la 0blud(sme/ 'phags pa dga' byed do(9/ /gal te nye dga'as kyang 'o thug rnyed par 'gyur na rtag pa kho nar dge slong ma la ston ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dge slong ma kha cig gis ni zho 'thug khyer te 'ongs/kha cig gis ni hwags kyi la du 7khyer te 'ongs pa dang / nye dga'as smras pa/kho bo ko tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed chos bzang po'i chos kyis dge slong ma la ston snyam gyi/ kho bo ko du tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed zas cung zad tsam gyi phyir dge slong ma la ston snyam mi sems so/ /dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge slong (sprernams la 'di skad ces dge slong dag zas chung phyizad tsam gyi phyir dge slong ma rnams la ston par byed ces zer zhes 0smod par byed /7—215

phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di ①dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nye dga' la rmas ②pa nye dga' khyod dge slong rnams la 'di skad ces dge slong dag ni zas chung ⑧zad tsam gyi phyir dge slong ma la ston to zhes zer ba bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong ①gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge slong rnams la 'di skad ces dge slong dag zas cung rjozad tsam gyi phyir dge slong ma la ston to zhes zer na ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni shākya'i bu nye dga' 'am/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /dge slong rnams la zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa rnams la'o/ /'di skad ces zhes bya ba ni 'di skad ces duzer na'o/ /dge slong dag ces bya ba ni chos 'di pa dag go/ /zas cung ⑦7—216

zad tsam gyi phyir zhes bya ba ni bca' ba lnga dang / bza' ba lnga'i phyir ro/ /dge slong ma la ①zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa la'o/ /ston to zhes zer na zhes bya ba ni lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang / lhag ②pa'i sems dang / lhag pa'i shes rab bo / /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang yi dwags dungan song dang / ngan du'agro dang log rjopar ltung ba dag tu sreg rjopar byed/ 'tshod ⑦par byed/ ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib ⑧par byed pa ste / des na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ⑨ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis ji tsam cung 0zad tsam dge slong rnams la 'di skad ces dge slong dag zas cung yizad tsam gyi phyir dge slong ma la ston to zhes zer na thams cad du ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /zas chung 8zad tsam gyi phyir dge slong ma la ston pa bden na ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /zas cung zad tsam gyi 8phyir ston pa'i 0ltung byed de nyi shu gsum pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na tshong dpon zhig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed / dga' bar byedabya/ dga' mgur rmyaspyod par byed do/ /de rgas pa'i gnas skabs su nye du zad par gyur cing nor zad pa dang / longs spyod zad 7—217

par gyur nas des chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo kho bos da nor sgrub ①par mi nus kyis ②kho bo rab tu 'byung du 'gro'o/ /chung mas smras pa/ rje'i 0sras bdag kyang rab tu 'byung ngo / /de ltar gyis shig ces des chung ma skye dgu'i rjobadag mo chen mo gi ta rmā'i 0gan du khrid de smras pa/ 'phags ma bdag gi mchis 'brang du'adi legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal na 'phags mas 'di rab tu dbyung du gsol/ rdzogs par bsnyen par mdzad du gsol / skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta sbis de rab tu phyung zhing rdzogs par bsnyen par byas sol/ /des tshong dpon la smras pa/ rje'i sras bud med kyi yul ni srid ⑧pa spyad pa lags kyis 0dus dang dus su spyon ⑩cig /tshong dpon de yang rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ste dge slong gi yigan du rab tu byung ngo / /mnyan yod pa'i tshong dpon rab tu byung ngo zhes de grags shing bsod nams che bas des de'i 8chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal dang /na ba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag grub po/ /de 0dus gzhan zhig na snam sbyar dmar ser gyon te dge slong ma de'i dbyar khang du song ba dang / dge slong ma des de'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ mdun du 'dug nas des ⑩de'i snam sbyar de la yang dang skeyang du rtog tshunas dge slong des smras pa/sring mo snam sbyar 'di 'dod dam/ des smras pa/ lha'i gnas kyi lhag ma bzhin du'o/ /des bsams ⑩pa/ bdag gi tso'adi la snam yisbyar 'di sbyin par bya zhing bdag rjogis snam sbyar gzhan btsem par bya'o snyam nas/ des de la snam sbyar de 0byin te song ngo / /de nas chabacom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams 7—218

la dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs kyis ①khyed cag las gang de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig ljongs ②rgyur 'gro bar ②spro ba des chos gos dag long shig ༷ces gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas dge slong rnams la tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs kyis dukhyed cag las gang de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig ༷ljongs rgyur 'gro bar spro ba des chos gos dag long ④shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba dang ldan pa/ zhi ba 'khor zhi ba dang ldan pa/grol ba 'khor grol ba dang ldan pa/ dbugs phyin pa 'khor dbugs phyin pa dang ldan pa/ thul ba 'khor thul ba dang ldan pa/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa dang ldan pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba dang ldan pa/ mdzes pa ⑧'khor mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ khyu mchog ltar ba lang gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ glang po che ltar glang po che'i phrug ⑨gu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ seng ge ltar mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar ngang pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nam mkha' lding ltar bya'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/bram ze ltar slob ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sman pa mkhas pa ltar nad pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ dpa' bo ltar ru pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sa mkhan ltar lam du zhugs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ded dpon ltar tshong ⑩pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ tshong dpon ltar 'khor gyi 7tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mkhar gyi rgyal po ltar 7—219

blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'khor los ①snar ba ltar bu ②stong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ zla ba ltar rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nyi ma ltar 'od zer stong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ yul 'khor srung ltar dri za'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'phags skyes po ltar grul bum gyi ①tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mig mi ༷bzang ltar klu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nor ⑤phyin ltar gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ thags zangs ༷ris ltar lha ma yin ⑦gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ brgya byin ltar sum bcu nirtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ tshangs pa ltar tshangs ris kyi 7tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/dbang po rnams kyis ⑩ shin tu dul bskye/ spyod lam dang spyod pa ma 'khrugs pa/chu gter ltar ting 8nge ba/ sprin ltar chu dang bcas pa/ glang po che'i rgyal po ltar dregs pa dang bral ba/ skyes 'bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu 8rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang tsopo brgyad bcus 8sku rnam par mdzes pa / 'od 'dom gang gis gzugs can brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun tu bzang ba/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag ⑫pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇḍi tunyergya dang /rlangs pa dang / ming chen dang / ma 'gags pa dang / shā ri'i bu dang /mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / 'od srung dang / kun dga' bo dang / nam gru la sogs pa nyan thos chen po dag dang / gzhan yang dge slong gi dge 'dun mang pos bskor te ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs so/ /chos nyid 2—220

kyis na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag ljongs rgyur gshegs pa na 'ga' zhig chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ༷ljongs rgyu bar mi 'gyur ram snyam pas ②sku thams cad kyis chagayas phyogs nas glang po che'i lta stangs rjokyis rnam par gzigs pa yin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'gro ba gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong dbyar gnas pa dag gis chos gos kyi 0rnyed pa ma grub bam/bcom ldan 'das grub bo/ /kun dga' bo 'o na ci'i phyir dge slong 'di chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'gro/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos skabs de bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong dag dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la gos dag sbyin namaX/ btsun pa stsal ⑦sto/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa ni 'di snyam du 'di'i chos gos gsum tshang ngamani/ 'on te ma tshang snyam du mi sems par 'di ltar thob bo cog len par byed kyi nye du la ni byin yang len par mi byed do / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang /skabs 'di la dge slong gi ⑨dge 'dun bsdu ⑩ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed ⑫par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs 8pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la rmas ⑩pa/ dge slong khyod dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la gos sbyin pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas ⑫7—221

bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong ①gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa / rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni ②rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnams grangs du mas ③rnam par smad ④nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi rjobaca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab rjopa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la gos phyin na ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o//dge slong ma zhes bya ba yang chos 'di pa'o/ /nye du ma yin pa la zhes bya ba ni phyi mo dang / mes po dang / phrugs ⑦las brten ⑧pa'i bdun pa tshun chad 0ni nye du yin la de phan chad ni nye du ma yin no/ /gos zhes bya ba ni bdun po bal gos dang / sha na'i gos dang / zar ma'i gos dang / du ⑩ga la'i gos dang /ras bal gyi gos dang / ko tam pa'i gos dang / nyi 'og gi gos dag las gang yang rung ba'o/ /sbyin na zhes bya ba ni bslang mi dgos 7par ro/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang log par ltung ba dag tu sreg tunyepar byed/'tshod par byed/ ltung bar byed pa'o/ — /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags tson dge ba'i 8chos rnams la sgrib 8par byed pa ste / des na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ⑩ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis dge slong ma nye ⑩du 7—222

ma yin pa la nye du ma yin par 'du shes pas gos byin ①na ltung byed du 'gyur ro//dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la yid gnyis za ②bas gos byin na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du la ②nye du ma yin par 'du ④shis pas gos byin na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du la nye du ma yin par yid gnyis za bas gos byin na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /bor brlag 0byung ba la sbyin pa dang / legs par smra ba la sbyin pa dang /dge slong ma'i dge 'dun la gos kyi sbyin pa ༅sbyin pa dang / rdzogs par bsnyen par byed pa la sbyin ⑦pa dang / rin gyi phyir sbyin pa dang / brje ba'i phyir sbyin pa la ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos ⑧pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /gos sbyin pa'i ltung byed de 7nyi shu bzhi pa rdzogs sto// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bzhi bcu ⑩ dgu pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong ma sbed ma'i chos gos lnga ngan cing snam sbyar yang rnyings nas/ des ras yug chen cig yirnyed pa dang de su zhig bdag gi chos gos tshem 8par 'gyur snyam du sems khong du 8chud cing 'dug pa na/dge slong ma rnams kyis ④de la smras pa/ sbed ma khyod ci'i phyir sems khong du ⑫chud cing 'dug/ phu nu mo dag kho mo chos gos lnga ngan cing snam sbyar yang rnyings tsonas kho mos ras yug chen ⑩zhig rnyed na/ kho mo'i chos gos su 'drub 8par 'gyur mi shes so/ /sbed ma khyod gser gyi snod kyis slong yimo la rgyu'am/ khyod 7—223

kyi dge slong 'phags pa 'char ka rab tu bshes ①pa yin no/ /sbed mas ②smras pa/des kho mo'i chos ③gos drubs par mi 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis de la dulan 'ga' bcol ba yod dam/ lan 'ga' yang bcol ba med do/ /ci khyod ⑤chu sgra grags pas lham 'bud dam/ song la chol 0cig dang ⑦'drub par 'gyur ro/ /sbed ma 'char ⑧ka'i gan du song ste/ de'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas mdun du 'dug ⑨pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus de'i ras yug chen mthong nas de la ⑩smras pa/ sbed ma gang la ras yug chen 'di lta bu yod pa des ras yisar ba las snam sbyar nyi rim tsobyas te tsosnying las chung ngus rdzidage ba'i 8phyogs la tron byas ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /sbed mas smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag khyod la ras yug chen mi 'bul ba ni ma lags na 'di ltar bdag gi ⑩chos gos lnga ngan cing snam sbyar yang rnyings pas khyod kyis 8bdag gi snam sbyar tshems te ⑩475 cig /'char 0kas bsams ⑥pa/ gal te re zhig btsem par byar yang bcu gnyis sde dag las gang dang gang dag la chos gos btsem par bya ba tsobyung bar gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bdag gi tsogan du khyer te 'ong bas de snyed cig btsem par yang ji ltar nus/ gal te mi btsem du ni ④tshig pa'i g.yar tshus dukyang mi ster cibar 'gyur bas 'di ltar ci nas kyang shing gi snod du bskol ba bzhin du dang po gang yin pa de nyid tha mar 'gyur ba de ltar btsem par bya'o snyam nas des de la smras pa / zhog la song shig /sbed mas rdzibazhag ste ⑥song ba dang / drug sde dag der dong nas de dag gis ras yug chen de mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa cha'achar ka ras yug chen 'di su'i/ las ⑥bdag gir bya 9ba de'i'o/ /gang gi sbed ma'i'o/ /'o na 'khod 9de ci rung cha7—224

btsem par bya'o/ /de ltar gyis shig /de dag gis ①ras yug chen ②de brgyangs te dras shing drubs nas 'char kus snam sbyar de dang tshon sna lnga'i skud pa khyer te 'chag tu song nas/ des der song ste ①snam sbyar de la tshon sna lnga'i skud pas bdag nyid sbed ma'i mgul nas 'khyud rjode 'dug pa zhig skud ris su btsem ⑤ nas de gtsug lag khang du 'ongs te snam sbyar de bltab nas chos gos kyi gdang ①la bkal te bzhag pa dang / sbed ma yang 'ongs nas 'char gas smras pa/sbed ma kho bos kyang snam sbyar btsems na ⑦khyod kyang 'ongs so/ /des snam sbyar de ⑧bltab bzhin du sbed ma'i phrag ⑨pa la bkal te ⑩smras pa/ re zhig ji srid du tshon gyis ⑩ma bcal ba 8de srid du ma dbye shig /ltung ba dang 8bcas par gyur ta re/ sbed mas snam sbyar de de bzhin bltab bzhin kho tsonar dbyar khang du 'phags pa dang / de la dge slong ma khrims zlas smras pa/ sbed ma 'phags pa 'char kus snam sbyar ji ltar btsems byapa bltas 'on cig /sbed mas ⑩de la smras pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka na re re zhig ji srid du tshon gyis ma bcal ba ⑩de srid du ma dbye shig /ltung ba dang bcas par gyur ta re zhes zer ro zhes ltar ⑫ma ster yiro/ /sbed ma dbyar khang du song ba dang / de la dge slong ma rnams kyis smras pa/ sbed ma 'phags pa 'char kus snam sbyar ji ltar btsems ⑩pa bltas 'on cig /sbed mas smras pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka na re re zhig ji srid du tshon gyis ma bcal ba de srid du ma dbye shig /ltung ba dang bcas par gyur ta 0re zhes zer ro/ /dge slong ma grogs mo dag gis 3'di la ltung bar 'gyur ba ci yod ces de'i rgyab logs su 'dug ste snam sbyar hur ces phrogs nas phye ste bltas pa dang / dge slong ma rnams ⑥kyis de la tshon sna tsolnga'i skud pas 'char 7—225

ka sbed ma'i mgul nas 'khyud ①de 'dug pa skud ris su btsems ②pa mthong nas rta gad kyis ③btab ste smras pa/ sbed ma khyod la 'phags pa 'char kus yun ring mo ༷zhig gis gzod du'akhyud do/ /skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo ༅gi ta sbos thos nas des smras pa/ nu mo dag khyed mgo phyi zhing mchan khung spun pa yin na ci dgodal/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags ma ji lta ⑤ji ltar 'phags pa 'char kus mi mdzes ⑨pa bgyis pa la gzigs/ nu mo dag drug sde gnas ngan len kun du spyod pa dag gis 'brums pa ltung bas bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑩bstan pa 'jig par byed do zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la brjod nas/ dge slong rnams kyis 0bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang /skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do 8zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la rmas yipa/ 'char ka khyod dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa'i gos byed pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi 8tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad rdo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas skedage slong rnams la bka' stsal pa / dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon skyabacu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ⑩bslab pa'i gzhi tsobaca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la 7—226

sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon ①par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa'i gos byed na ltung byed dol/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni 'char ku'am/gzhan yang de lta ③bu gang yin pa'o/ /dge slong ma zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o/ /nye du ma yin pa'i zhes bya ba ni phyi mo dang / mes po dang / phrugs kyi bdun pa tshun chad ni nye du yin la/ de phan chad ni nye du ma yin no/ /gos zhes bya ba ni bdun po bal gos dang / sha na'i gos dang / zar ma'i gos dang /du gu la'i gos dang / ras bal gyi gos dang / ko tam pa'i gos dang / nyi du'og gi ①gos dag las gang yang rung ba'o/ /byed na zhes bya ba ni 'tshem na'o/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags ⑥ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang / log par ltung ba dag tu sreg ⑦par byed/ 'tshod par byed ltung ⑧bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib ⑨par byed pa ste/ des na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ⑩ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du ma 7yin pa la nye du ma yin par 'du tsoshes pas gos byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro//dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la yid gnyis za bas tsogos byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du byal 8nye du ma yin par 'du ⑩shes pas gos 0byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du la yid gnyis za bas gos byed na nyes byas 8su 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos ⑩pa dang / sems 'khrugs 0pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa 7—227

la ltung ba med do/ /gos byed pa'i ltung byed de nyi shu lnga pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis ②smras pa/dga' bo nye dga' lhung bzed nag po can 'di dag ni rkang pa spre'u zhag ②gis bskus te 'gro na ②yang 'gro bar chas 0pa'i rnyed pa sgrub par byed/ 'ong na yang blo 0bur du 'ongs pa'i rnyed pa sgrub 0par byed cing / skye bo mang po dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar 0yang 'gyur ro/ /yu bu cag ni khron pa'i rus ⑧sbal dang 'dra bar gar yang mi 'dong / gang nas kyang mi 'ong bas ⑨rnyed pa 'thob pa dang / skye bo mang po dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar ga la 'gyur gyisati / yu bu cag kyang 'dong ngo / /gang du 'dong ⑩/ ljongs rgyur 'dong ngo / /je 0sring mo dag blta'o zhes de dag snga dro sham 'thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms ④la zhugs nas 8de dag dge slong ma'i dbyar khang du dong ⑩ste bcu gnyis sde dag gi gan du song nas smras pa/sring mo dag khyed cag bltas kyis 0kho bo cag ljongs 8rgyur 'dong ngo / /de dag dus pa dang / drug sde dag gis smras pa/ sring mo dag ngur ci yod/ gal te khyed cag ljongs rgyur bzhud na bdag cag la rgyal byed kyi tshal stongs par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das 'khor stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang bzhugs na khyed cag bdag cag la rgyal byed kyi tshal stongs ⑩par 'gyur ro zhes zer ram/ de dag gis smras pa/ lhung bzed nag po can dag bdag cag mthong bar yang mi dga' na mchi ba dang / stan 'ding du7—228

ba dang / chos ston par lta ga la 'gyur/ nye dga'as smras pa/ sring mo dag 'o na lhan cig 'dong ngo / /sbom dga' mos smras pa/ dge slong ma dag dge slong rnams ①dang lhan cig mchir ①rung ngam / nye dga'as smras pa/ legs par rung ngo shin tu rung ngo gang 0du bkag sus bkag lam rgyags dumang po dag sta gon gyis shig /de dag gis lam rgyags rjomang po dag sta gon byas so/ /drug sde dag snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas/ de dag mnyan yod du bsod snyoms brgyus nas dge slong ma'i dbyar khang du dong ba dang / de dag la bcu gnyis sde dag gis smras pa/ jo bo cag je zhal tshus ⑦gsol cig /de dag gis g.yar tshus byas ⑧byas pa na de dag gis lam rgyags sbyar ba ⑨thams cad zos nas de dag gis smras pa/ sring mo dag khyed kyis lam rgyags ⑩ji snyed sta gon byas pa bltas ⑩'on cig /de dag gis smras pa/ khyed kyis chagasol ba de dag lags so/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ lam rgyags tsode tsam gyis ljongs rgyur ji ltar nus/'di ltar lam kur lhag par bkres 8par 'gyur gyis tshulam rgyags tsomang du sta gon gyis shig /de dag gis lam rgyags ⑩mang po dag sta gon byas te drug sde tsodag dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur 'phags so/ /bsod snyoms pa zhig kyang de dag dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur 'phags pa dang dge slong rnams kyis de la smras pa/bsod snyoms pa 'di dag ni gnas ngan len kun du spyod pa yin gyis ⑪khyod 'di dag dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur ma 'gro shig /khyod la mtho cha'atsham par 'gyur ro//bsod snyoms pas smras pa/ kho bo lo 'das pa 0yin pas 'di dag la dulung mnod pa dang / bklag ⑥pa dang / kha ton dang / yongs su dri ba dang /7—229

rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba 'ga' yang rag ma las ①pas 'di dag gis ②kho bo la tho btsam ③du ci yod ces des de dag gi 0tshig tshig ma yin par byas te ⑤drug sde dag dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur 'phags so/ /de dag gis/ gang gi tshe dumatshams kyi ⑦phyi rol tu son pa de'i tshe na smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bdag cag gis yun ji srid du gzhan gyi spyod lam gyis 'khod par bya/ tshur sheg bdag cag rang rang gi ⑧spyod lam gyis 'khod par bya'o zhes dang por dga' bo 'dug nas de'i 'og tu ⑨dga' mo 'dug /de'i 'og tu dga' bo'i lhan cig gnas pa 'dug /de'i 'og tu ⑩dga' mo'i lhan cig gnas pa 'dug /de'i 'og tu dga' bo'i dge tshul 'dug /de'i 'og tu yidaga' mo'i dge tshul ⑫'dug go/ /de bzhin du nye dga' dang / gtsug dga' mo la sogs pa 8yang spel mar bkod de dong ngo / /don mthun de dang bram ze zhig 'gro ba des de dag mthong nas des 0smras pa/ 'di ni dge sbyong yin/ de'i chung ma ni 'di yin / de'i bu ni 'di yin/ de'i mna' tsom ni 'di yin/ de'i tsha bo 'di yin/⑩ de'i tsha bo'i chung ma ni 'di yin par shes so/ /nye dga'as thos nas des ⑩smras pa/ bkren pa khyod kyi gnya' ba rdog pas mnan nas 'di ni kho bo'i 8chung tsom yin/ 'di ni kho'i 0bu yin/ 'di ni kho'i ⑥mna' ma yin/'di ni kho bo'i tsha bo yin3/ 'di ni kho bo'i tsha bo'i chung ma yin0/ bsod snyoms ⑥pa des bsams byapa bdag shi ba ni bla'i gnas ngan len kun tu spyod pa 'di dag dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur 'gro ba ni mi rung ngo ③snyam nas de 0phyir log ste 3rgyal byed kyi 0tshal du song ba dang / dge slong rnams kyis de mthong nas smras pa/ bsod snyoms pa ji lta bde bar brgyus sam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ji 7—230

ltar bde bar brgyus/ drug sde gnas ngan len kun tu spyod pa dag gis 'brums ①pa ltung bas bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyabastan pa 'jig par byed do/ /ci byas / des skabs de dge slong rnams la rgyas par brjod ②pa dang / dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams nas 'gron dulam du 'jug par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang /gleng ⑤gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dudage 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do//zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs ⑦pa yang snga ma bzhin te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis drug sde dag la rmas ⑧pa/ dge slong dag khyed dge slong ma'i don mthun ⑨dang lhan cig 'thams nas 'gron 0lam du 'jug pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no/ /zhes rnam par smad pa ⑩mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/yang dge slong gang dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams tshunas 'gron ⑫7—231

lam du 'jug na ltung byed do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi de ①ltar bca' ba mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dge slong ma rab tu mang po dag rgyal po'i khab tu dge slong ma'i dbyar khang rgyal po'i kun dga' ra bar ②dbyar gnas par khas blangs nas de dag dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po sridag 'das nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi ༷zhabs la phyag 'tshal du mnyan yod du 'phags nas de dag gis ⑤mnyan yod du 'gro ba'i don mthun btsal bar brtsams 0pa dang / ji tsam na de ⑦dag gis ⑧dge slong dang bcas pa'i don mthun mthong nas smras pa/phu nu mo dag don mthun 'di ni dge slong dang bcas ⑨pa yin gyisakyi/ dge slong med pa'i don mthun gzhan skyebatsal bar bya'o/ /zhes de dag gis dge tshoslong med pa'i don mthun gzhan btsal bar brtsams 8pa dang / ji tsam na dge slong med pa'i don mthun ma rnyed nas de dag gis smras pa/ phu nu mo dag bdag cag gis shin tu yun ring por bsdad na yang dge slong med pa'i don mthun ma rnyed kyis ⑩don mthun 'di nyid dang mgo snang tsam gyis 'dong bar bya'o//zhes de dag don tsomathun de dang lhan cig mgo snang tsam gyis 'phags so/ /don mthun de shin tu rings 8par skyasong nas de dag phyi bzhin 'brang zhing 'gro ba na chom rkun pa dag gis bcom nas de dag mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin te dge slong ma'i dbyar khang du dong ba dang dge slong ma rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa / phu nu mo chadag ji lta 8bde bar brgyus sam/ ji ltar bde bar brgyus/bdag cag chom rkun pa dag gis bcom mo/ /phu nu mo dag ji ltar bdag cag 2—232

bcom ldan 'das kyis yongs su btang ba de ltar ni ya mtshan can dgu bcu rtsa drug po dag gis kyang bud med kyi yul 'gazha yang yongs su ma btang ①ngo / /zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la brjod nas dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na/ dus ma gtogs so/ /dge slong dag don mthun dang lhan ②cig ljongs rgyur 'dong ba na de dag bsod snyoms kyis ①phongs par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa lam rgyags bskur 0bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lam rgyags bskur ⑤bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas de dag gis sus bskur ༷bar bya ba ⑦mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rtse rgod ②kyis bskur ⑨bar bya'o/ /rtse rgod tshumed yin rtse rgod mos bskur chubar bya'ol/ /rtse rgod mo med na dge tshul gyis bskur 8bar bya'o/ /dge tshul med na dge tshul mas bskur byabar bya'o/ /dge tshul ma med na dge slong rnams kyis dge slong ma'i lam rgyags bskur byabar bya zhing / dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams kyi tshulam rgyags bskur ⑩bar bya ste/ dge slong rnams kyis dge slong ma rnams kyi 'byin len bstab ⑩par bya zhing / dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams kyi ⑩byin len bstab 0par bya'o/ /dge slong dag ljongs rgyu zhing 'dong ba na na bar gyur nas dge slong ma dag gis de dag bor te dong nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong ma rnams sakyis kyang dge slong dag bkur dubar bya'o/ /dge slong ma dag rkang pa logs nas 'dzin cing dge slong dag mgo logs nas 'dzin pa na dge slong ma dag 'dod chags skyes nas 7—233

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gis rkang pa logs nas gzung ①bar bya zhing / dge slong ma ②dag gis mgo logs nas gzung ③bar bya'o / /de dag grong du phyin nas thams cad sdod pa na/ de dag bsod snyoms kyis phongs par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/thams cad kyis bsdad par mi bya bar de na ba'i sman dang zan legs par sbyar te rjodage slong gcig bzhag dunas lhag ma rnams 'dong bar bya'o/ /dge slong ma rnams la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa 'dod pa dang / bslab pa la gus pa rjodang / bslab pa la yo byad ⑦bsnyungs pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la de dang mthun pa dang / de'i shas che ba dang / de dang 'tsham ⑧pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid mdzad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na snga ma ni bcas pa yin la/ 'di 0ni gnang ba yin te/ nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab ⑩pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams nas 'gron 0lam du 'jug na dus ma gtogs te ltung byed do/ /de la dus ⑩ni 'di 8yin te/ lam don mthun gyis bgrod par bya ba dogs 8pa dang bcas par grags pa/ 'jigs ⑫pa dang bcas par grags pa/ 'jigs pa tha dad pas 'jigs su rung ba dang bcas par grags pa zhig na de la de ni dus yin no/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni drug sde'am gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig ces bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o/ /'thams nas zhes bya ba ni brda' ⑩byas nas so/ /'gron tshulam du zhes bya ba ni dgon pa'i lam du'o/ /7—234

'jug na zhes bya ba ni 'gro na'o/ /dus ma gtogs ①te zhes bya ba ni ②dus bzhag ste'o/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang ③/ log par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/ 'tshod ༷par byed/ ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so dusor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la ༷sgrib par byed pa ste/ des na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la dus ni 'di yin te lam don mthun gyis bgrod ⑦par bya ba ⑧zhes bya ba ni don mthun med par bgrod mi nus pa'o/ /dogs ⑨pa dang bcas par grags pa zhes bya ba ni chom rkun pa dang g.yon can gyis 'jigs par grags pa'o/ / 'jigs pa ⑩dang bcas par grags pa zhes bya ba ni seng ge dang / stag dang /gung gis 'jigs par grags pa'o/ /'jigs pa tha dad pas 'jigs su rung ba dang bcas par grags ⑩pa zhig na zhes bya ba ni sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu mchu rings dang / rlung dang / nyi ma dang / sdig sbrul gyi 8'jigs ⑩pa tha dad pas 'jigs su rung ba dang bcas par grags pa zhig na'o//de la 0ltung bar 'ji ltar 'gyur zhe tson/ dge slong gis ji tsam cung zad dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams nas 'gron ⑩lam du 'jug na rgyang grags phyed phyed du nyes byas su 'gyur roX/ /rgyang grags re rer lhung byed du 'gyur tho)ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams nas grong nas dgon pa'i 'gron 0lam du 'jug 0na grong rgyang grags kyis bar du chod pa bdun po dag gi durgyang grags phyed phyed du nyes byas su 'gyur ladu / rgyang grags re rer chasang byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong 7—235

ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams ①nas dgon pa nas grong gi 'gron ②lam du 'jug ②na grong rgyang grags kyis bar du chod pa bdun po dag gi 0rgyang grags phyed phyed du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rgyang grags re rer ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen ⑤pa la ltung ba med do/ /dge slong ma dang lhan cig 'gron ༷lam du 'jug ⑦pa'i ltung byed de nyi shu drug pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/dga' bo nye dga' lhung ⑧bzed nag po can 'di dag ni rkang pa spre'u zhag gis ⑨bskus byate/ 'gron yin yang 'gro bar chas pas rnyed 8pa sgrub 8par byedabya/'ong na yang blo 'bur du 'ongs pa'i rnyed ⑩pa sgrub ⑩par byed cing / skye bo mang po dag dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar yang 'gyur ro/ /yu bu cag ni ⑫khron pa'i rus 7sbal dang 'dra bar gar yang mi 'dong ⑥/ gang nas kyang mi 'ong bas rnyed pa thob ⑥pa dang / skye bo mang po dag dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar ga la 'gyur gyis 9yu bu cag kyang 'dong ngo / /gang du 'dong /ljongs rgyur 'dong ngo / /je dusring mo dag blta'o zhes de dag snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas de dag dge slong ma'i dbyar khang du dong ste bcu gnyis sde dag gi gan du dong nas smras pa/ sring mo dag khyed cag bltas kyis 'kho bo cag ljongs rgyur 'dong ngo / /de dag ngus pa dang / drug sde dag gis smras pa/ sring mo dag 7—236

ngur ci yod/ gal te khyed cag ljongs rgyur bzhud na bdag cag la rgyal byed kyi tshal stongs par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das 'khor stong nyis ①brgya lnga bcu dang bzhugs na/ khyed ②cag bdag cag la rgyal byed kyi ②tshal stongs par 'gyur ro zhes zer ram de dag gis smras pa/lhung bzed nag po can dag bdag cag mthong bar yang mi dga' na/ mchi ba rjodang stan gding ba dang / chos ston par lta ⑤ga la 'gyur/ nye dga'as smras pa / sring mo dag 'o na lhan cig 'dong ngo de dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams nas 'gron rjolam du 'jug na dus ma gtogs te ltung byed do zhes bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba ma mdzad dam/ nye dga'as smras pa/ de ni skam sa'i lam du bca' ba mdzad pas bdag cag gru'i lam du 'dong ngo / /sbom dga' mos ⑦smras pa/ dge slong ma dag dge slong dag dang lhan cig gru'i lam du mchir rung ngam/ nye ⑧dga'as smras pa/ legs par rung 0ngo / /shin tu rung ngo / /gang du bkagasus bkag /lam rgyags ⑩mang po dag sta gon gyis shig /de dag gis lam rgyags skyemang po 8dag lta tigon byas so/ /drug sde dag snga dro sham thabs bgos/lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas/de dag mnyan yod du bsod snyoms brgyus nas dge slong ma'i dbyar khang du dong ⑫ba dang / de dag la bcu gnyis sde dag gis smras pa/ jo tsobo cag je 8zhal tshus cigasol cig /de dag gis g.yar tshus byas pa na de dag gis tsolam rgyags ⑩sbyar ba thams cad zos nas/ de dag gis smras pa/ sring mo dag khyed ⑥kyis lam rgyags 0ji snyed dusta gon byas pa bltas 'on cig /de dag gis smras pa /7—237

khyed kyis gsol pa de dag lags so/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ lam rgyags ①de tsam gyis ljongs rgyur ji ltar nus/ 'di ltar lam kur lhag ②par bkres par 'gyur gyis rgyalam rgyags ༷mang du sta gon gyis shig /de dag gis lam rgyags dumang po dag sta gon byas te drug sde dag dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur 'phags so/ /bsod snyoms pa zhig kyang de dag dang ljongs rgyur 'phags pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis de la smras pa/ bsod snyoms pa 'di dag ni gnas ngan len kun du spyod pa yin gyis du'adi dag dang lhan cig ljongs rgyur ma 'gro shig /khyod ⑦la mtho 'tsham ⑧par 'gyur ro/ /bsod snyoms pas smras pa/kho bo lo 'das pa yin pas 'di dag la lung mnod ⑨pa dang / bklag pa dang /⑩kha ton dang / yongs su dri ba yidang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba 'ga' yang rag ma las 8pas 'di dag gis 'kho bo la tho btsam 0du ci yod ces des 8de dag gi tshig tshig ma yin par byas te/ drug sde dag dang lhan cig grur 'jug 8tu 'phags so/ /de dag gis ⑩gang gi tshe mtshams 8kyi 7phyi rol du son pa de'i tshe na smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' bdag cag gis yun ji srid du gzhan gyi spyod lam gyis 'khod par bya/ tshur gshegs cibadag cag rang rang 0gi spyod lam gyis 'khod par bya'o/ /zhes dang por dga' bo du'adug nas/ de'i 'og tu dga' mo 'dug /de'i 'og tu dga' bo'i lhan cig gnas pa 'dug /de'i 'og tu dga' mo'i 3lhan cig gnas pa 'dug /de'i 'og tu dga' bo'i dge tshul 'dug /de'i 'og tu dga' mo'i dge tshul ma cha'adug /de bzhin du nye dga' dang / gtsug dudaga' mo la sogs pa 0yang spel mar bkod de dong 0ngo / /don mthun de dang bram ze zhig lhan cig 'gro ba des de dag 7—238

mthong nas des smras pa/ 'di ni dge sbyong yin de'i chung ma ni 'di yin de'i bu ni 'di yin de'i mna' ma ni 'di yin/ de'i tsha bo ①ni 'di yin/ de'i tsha bo'i chung ma ni 'di yin par shes so/ /nye sridaga'as thos nas des ②smras pa/bkren rjopa khyod kyi ⑤gnya' ba rdog pas mnan nas 'di ni kho bo'i chung ma yin/'di ni kho bo'i bu yin/ 'di ni kho bo'i mna' ma yin/ 'di ni kho bo'i tsha bo yin / 'di ni kho bo'i tsha bo'i chung ma yin no/ /bsod snyoms 0pa des bsams ⑦pa bdag shi ba ni bla'i gnas ngan len kun du spyod pa 'di dag dang lhan cig grur ⑧zhugs te 'gro ba ni mi rung ngo snyam nas/ de 0phyir log ste ⑨rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba dang / dge slong rnams kyis de mthong nas smras pa/bsod snyoms ⑩pa ji lta bde bar brgyus sam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'ji ltar bde bar brgyus/ drug sde chaganas ngan len kun du spyod pa dag gis 'drums pa ltung bas bcom ldan 'das kyi (9bstan pa 'jig par byed do/ /ci byas/des 8skabs de dge slong rnams la rgyas par brjod pa dang / dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams nas gru gcig tu 'jug par byed ⑩ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams ⑩kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng tsogazhi 'di yidang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang du snga ma bzhin te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis drug sde dag la rmas 0pa/ dge slong dag 7—239

khyed ①dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig ②'thams nas gru ⑧gcig ①tu 'jug pa bden nam btsun pa mad rjodo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi 0tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no/ /zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam ⑦grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ⑧bslab pa'i gzhi khyabaca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis ⑩'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/yang dge slong gang dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams nas gru gcig (7tu 'jug cing gyen du 'gro'am/ thur du 'gro na ltung byed do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab 8pa'i gzhi de ltar bca' ba mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na khyim bdag cig 0gis chu klung gnas can gyi 8pa rol 8thi ba can gyi kun dga' ra bar tsodage 'dun gyi phyir gtsug lag khang byed du bcug nas/ des gtsug lag tshukhang de dbul ba'i phyir gnyis ma'i tsodage 'dun spyan drangs so/ /dge slong ma zhig dge ba'i phyogs la brtson par gyur pa des bsams ⑩pa/ deng 0bdag gis bsod snyoms nyel brgyu dumi dgos pas ji srid du gdugs tshod la nye bar ma gyur pa de srid kyi bar du dge ba'i phyogs la tron bya zhing / de'i 'og tu dus shes par 7—240

byas te 'gro'o snyam ①nas des ji srid du gdugs tshod la nye bar ma gyur pa de srid kyi bar du dge ba'i phyogs la tron ②byas nas/ de'i 'og tu dus shes par byas te chu klung gi 'gram du song ba dang / ji tsam na dge slong dag ⑧gyur zhugs nas gru pas smras pa/ 'phags ma ༷grur ⑧zhugs shig /bzhin bzangs je dusong shig dang / gru gzhan bkang ba na 'gro'o⑦/ /gru pa des yang dang yang du 'ongs te smras pa/ 'phags ma grur zhugs shig /des kyang smras pa/bzhin bzangs nirje song shig dang ⑨/ gru gzhan skyabakang ba na 'gro'o/ /gru pa de 7song nas chu klung gi pha rol du gru phur pa la brtod de/ skye bo phal po che'i tshogs kyi nang du zhugs shing 'dug go/ /dge slong ma des yang dang yang du bos pa dang / gru pa 8des tshig 8kyang ma ster nas de de na sdod sdod nas ji tsam ⑫na gdugs tshod yol nas/ de'i 'og tu dbyar khang du phyir log ste de 'ji srid du lus las mdangs tsom yal ba de srid kyi bar du dge ba'i phyogs la tron ⑩byas nas / gang gi tshe lus las mdangs yal ba de'i tshe na glos phab ste nyal ba dang /dge slong ma rnams lhags te de la smras pa/ 'phags ma gal te zas gzhan gyi yin zhes te 8sto yang gzhan gyi ⑥yin snyam mamadu/ ci byas/ ji 0tsam gyis glos phab ste dunyal bar gyur pa de tsam gyis zas zos so/ /sus duzos/ khyod tshokyis so/ /kho mos ma zos so/ /'o na ci'i phyir glos phab ste nyal/ des skabs de rgyas par dge slong ma rnams la brjod nas dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la brjod do/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na thad kur pha rol du 'gro ba ma gtogs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 7—241

bslab pa 'dod pa dang / bslab ①pa la gus pa dang / bslab ②pa la yo byad bsnyungs pa'i bsngags ①pa brjod nas/ dge slong rnams la de dang mthun pa dang / de'i shas che ba dang / de dang 'tsham dupa'i chos dang ldan pa'i bka' ⑤mchid mdzad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na snga ma ni bcas pa yin la/ 'di ni gnang ba yin te/ nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab dupa'i gzhi 'di ltar ⑦gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams nas gru gcig nitu 'jug cing gyen du 'gro'am/ thur du 'gro ⑨na thad kur pha rol du 'gro ba ma gtogs te ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni drug sde ⑩'am/gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig ⑫ces bya ba ni chos 'di pa'i'o⑩/ /'thams nas zhes bya ba ni brda tsobyas nas so//gru gcig tu zhes bya ba ni sho gam gcig pa dang / la gcan gcig pa dang /gru btsas gcig par ro/ /'jug cing zhes bya ba ni zhon zhing ngo / /gyen du 'gro'am zhes bya ba ni rgyun las bzlog 8phyogs su 'gro ba'o/ /thur du 'gro na ⑫zhes bya ba ni rgyun phyogs su 'gro na'o(9/ /thad kur pha rol du 'gro ba ma gtogs te zhes bya ba ni thad kur pha rol du 'gro ba bzhag ste'o/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ⑩ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang / log 8par ltung ba dag tu sreg ⑩par byed/'tshod par byed/ ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing / so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib 0par byed pa ste/ des na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//2—242

de la ltung bar ①ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis ji tsam cung zad dge slong ma'i don mthun ②dang lhan cig 'thams nas gru gcig tu 'jug cing gyen du 'gro'am/ thur du 'gro na rgyang grags phyed phyed du nyes byas su 'gyur la/rgyang grags re rer ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig 'thams nas grong ninas dgon par gru gcig ①tu 'jug cing gyen du 'gro'am/ thur du 'gro na grong rgyang grags kyis bar du chod rjopa bdun po rjodag gi ⑦rgyang grags phyed phyed du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rgyang grags re rer ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma'i don mthun dang lhan cig ⑧'thams nas dgon pa nas grong du gru gcig tu 'jug cing lagyen du 'gro'am / thur du ⑩'gro na grong rgyang grags kyis bar du ma yichod pa bdun po dag gi 8rgyang grags 'phyed phyed du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rgyang grags re rer ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /yo ba las bzur ba byadang / gtib chad pa 8las bzur ba dang / dba' klong ⑩las bzur ba dang / ru skya chag ⑩pa dang /gdos pa chag 8pa dang / ru skya 'dzin pa mi nyan pa la ltung ba med do/ /'gram gnyis na bar chad brgyad po dag las gang yang rung ba nye bar gnas na ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen ⑩pa la ltung ba med do/ /dge slong ma dang lhan cig grur 'jug ⑥pa'i snang byed de nyenyi shu bdun pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bla7—243

snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas mthar gyis mnyan yod du ①bsod snyoms la rgyu ba na khyim bdag gi chung ma sbed ma'i khyim ga la ba der song ngo / /khyim bdag gi chung ma sbed mas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka thag ②ring po kho na nas mthong stedu/ mthong nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i phyir dustan shom rjopar byed cing 'di skad ces kyang ༅smras so/ /btsun pa 'char ka tshur spyon btsun pa 'char ka byon pa legs so/ /btsun pa 'char ka gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs shig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka kha nang du bltas te 'dug go/ /khyim bdag gi chung ma sbed ma ④yang tshe dang ldan pa 'char nika'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te kha phyir bltas te 'dug go/ /'char gas de la ji tsam pa de tsam gyis chos bstan nas sngon bgad ⑨pa dang / rtses ⑩pa dang / dga' ba byas pa dang / dga' mgur yispyad pa dag dran par bya bar 8brtsams te④/ sbed ma khyod kyis bdag cag gnyis skyed ④mos tshal dang / 'dun sa dang / lha'i gnas ga tsoge mo zhig tu bca' ba 'di dang 'di lta bu 'chos pa tsodang / bza' ba 'di dang 'di lta bu 0zos pa dang / btung ba 'di dang 'di lta bu 'thungs pa phyedang /gnas mal 'di dang 'di lta bu bshams pa dang / 'bru mar gyi mar me 'di dang 'di lta bu btsugs yishing der bdag cag gnyis kyis 'di dang 'di lta bu byas pa dran nam/ sbed mas smras pa dran no0/ /bsod snyoms pa zhig snga dro sham ⑥thabs bgos lhung ⑤bzed dang chos gos thogs te 'amanyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas/ de mthar gyis mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la rgyu ba na khyim bdag gi chung ma sbed ma'i khyim ga la ba der song ba dang khyim bdag gi chung ma 7—244

sbed ①mas de mthong nas des bsams ②pa gal te langs te②/ bsod snyoms phul bar gyur na btsun pa 'char ku'i gtam spangs par 'gyur ro snyam nas des 0lag pas song shig ces brda byas so/ /'char kus sbed dum lag brda byed pa mthong nas des 0smras pa/ sbed ma khyod kho bo 'dug bzhin du mdun du ⑦skyes pa ⑧gzhan dang lhan cig lag brda byed dam sbed mas smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag skyes pa gzhan dang lag brda mi bgyid de/ 'di ltar bsod snyoms pa zhig mchis nas bdag gis bsams ⑨pa gal te langs te⑩/ bsod snyoms phul bar gyur na 'phags pa'i bka' mchid 7spangs par 'gyur ro snyam tsonas bdag gis de la mchis ⑩shig ces lag brda ④bgyis so/ /'char kus smras pa sbed ma ⑫khyod kyi tsosnying lam na 0kho bos khyod la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i ⑫gtam byas snyam mam yici 'di ltar kho bos lag pas bcal 0ba brgya dag gis longs spyod dag bsgrubs na khyod kyis sbyin pa dag byin 0zhing bsod nams dag dubyed kyang mi nus sam/ sbed dums bsod snyoms pa de bos te bca' ba dang /bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pa dag gis lhung bzed bkang ste byin nas des de cikhyer te song ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka blazas kyi bya ba byas te gtsug lag khang du song ba dang / bsod snyoms pa des bsams pa/ btsun pa 'char ka la tsogatam bya zhing thos nas mchog tu dga' ba bskyed par bya'o snyam nas des de la smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka mchog tu dga' ba skyed ⑩cig /deng don gyis na bdag gis khyod kyi bsod snyoms zos so/ /bsod snyoms pa shes te des dang por khyod bos snyam mam 9ci des khyod song shig ces lag brda byas nas kho bos ⑥de'i 'og tu de'i 0phyir 'bod du bcug go/ /ci byin/ bca' ba dang 7—245

bza' ba gtsang ①zhing bsod pas lhung bzed bkang ste byin te ②btsun pa 'char ka de ni khyod kyi yin no/ /de'i tshe na btsun pa 'char ka de nyid na 'dug par gyur tam 'dug go/ /khyod bud med kyi yul dang lhan cig gcig pu cig chadang dben pa skyabs yod pa na stan la 'dug tu rung ngam rung yang srid mi rung yang srid de /lo bo de ltar 'dug go/ /rjobasod snyoms pa khyod kyi dudeng de ltar kho bo'i bsod snyoms zos shing gal te mi bzod na kho bo las brten te rjobaslab ⑦pa'i gzhi 'char chug shig⑧ /ci de kho bos yal bar ⑨bor du re'am zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams la brjod pa dang / dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag bud med kyi 0yul dang lhan cig gcig pu cig yodang dben pa skyabs yod pa na stan la 'dug par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar 8ka gtong bar byed kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis shācom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'byung ba 'di dang gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs ④'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs ⑩pa yang snga ma bzhin te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la rmas ⑩pa 'char ka khyod bud med kyi yul dang lhan cig gcig pu cig tshudang dben pa skyabs yod pa na stan la 'dug par byed pa bden nam 8btsun ⑩pa mad dudo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi 0tshul ma yin pa rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas ⑤bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa dumadzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 7—246

rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste/ zhes bya ba ①la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis ②'dul ba la bslab ③pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang bud dumed kyi yul dang lhan cig gcig pu cig dudang dben pa skyabs yod pa na stan la 'dug na ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni 'char ku'am/ gzhan yang rjode lta bu gang yin pa'o//bud med kyi yul dang zhes bya ba ni bud med dam/ gzhon nu ma ⑦mi tshangs par spyod pa sprod pa las byung ba'i chos sten ②nus pa dang ngo / /lhan cig ces bya ba ni de ⑨dang lhan cig go/ /gcig ⑩phu cig yidang zhes bya ba ni de tsodang ngo / /dben pa zhes bya ba ni gang na bud 0med dang 8skyes 8pa dang ma ning gzhan 'ga' yang med pa'o⑩/ /skyabs yod pa ⑩zhes bya ba ni lngas bskyabs 8pa na ste/rtsig pas bskyabs ()pa dang / rib mas bskyabs 0pa dang / yol bas bskyabs ⑥pa dang / thibs pos bskyabs dupa dang / mtshan mos bskyabs pa na'odu / /stan la ④zhes bya ba ni gzhi la'o/ /'dug na zhes bya ba ni 'dom gang gi blanang du rkub tshos 0'jog par byed na'o⑦/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ngan song dang /ngan 'gro dang / log 3par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/ 'tshod par byed ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/ des na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//7—247

de la ltung ba ra ①ji ltar 'gyur zhe ②na dge slong gis ji tsam cung zad bud med kyi yul dang lhan cig gcig ②phu cig rjodang dben pa skyabs 0yod pa na stan la 'dug na thams cad du ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /sgo khang dun 'dug pa dang sman 'thag tu 'jud ⑦pa dang sgo ma bcad par 'dug pa dang / gzhan dag 'jug cing gzhan dag 'byung na ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang /smyos ⑧pa dang sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen ⑨pa la ltung ba med do/ /gcig pu 'dug pa'i ltung byed de nyi shu brgyad pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe sbed ⑩ma rab tu byung ⑪nas de dge skos 'byed pa na dge slong ma rnams snga dro sham 0thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te bsod snyoms tsol dong ba na sbed ma gtsug lag khang na ⑩phyag dar byed cing 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char 0ka yang snga dro sham 0thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs 8te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas⑥/ mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la durgyu ba na dge slong ma'i dbyar khang ga la ba der song ngo / /sbed ma dge slong ma'i dbyar khang na phyag dar byed cing 'dug pa des tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka thag ring po kho na nas mthong ste mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces smras ⑥so/ /'phags pa 'char duka byon pa legs so 'byon pa legs so zhes des phyags tsom phyogs gcig byatu bzhag tsonas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te mdun du 'greng ngo //'char kus de la ji tsam pa de tsam gyis 0chos bstan nas sngon bgad 9pa dang 7—248

rtses pa ①dang / dga' ba byas ②pa dang dga' mgur spyad ⑧pa dag dran par bya bar brtsams te 0sbed ma khyod kyis bdag cag skyed 0mos tshal dang /'dun dus dang lha'i gnas ga ge mo zhig tu bca' ba 'di dang 'di lta bu 'chos ⑦pa dang bza' ba 'di dang 'di lta bu zos pa dang / btung ba 'di dang 'di lta bu 'thungs pa ⑧dang gnas mal 'di dang 'di lta bu bshams ⑨pa dang 'bru mar gyi ⑩mar me 'di dang 'di lta bu btsugs ⑩shing der bdag cag gnyis kyis 'di dang 'di lta bu byas pa dran nam/ sbed mas smras pa dran no/ /de nas tsodage slong ma rgan mo nad ma 8zhig 'dug nas des bsams 8pa/ 'di gnyis ci'i phyir na ma bag tsomar blangs pa tshun chad kyang gcig la gcig rjod ⑩par byed snyam mo/ /sbed mas smras pa/ 'phags pa da ⑩bzhud cig dge slong ma dag mchi tsobar 'gyur zhing dbyar khang yiphyag dar ma bgyis par mchis pas dge slong ma dag smod par 'gyur ro zhes des phyags byam blangs pa dang 'char ka song 0ngo //sbed mas gtsug lag dukhung phyag dar bya bar brtsams pa dang / dge slong ma de dag kyang lhags dunas ⑥de dag gis smras pa/ sbed ma khyod kyis ci byas na dbyar khang 'di de kho na bzhin du phyag dar dang bcas par 'dug /sbed phyems smras pa phu nu mo dag gang tshun chad nas khyed cag bsod snyoms la dong ba de ③tshun chad nas kho mo sa la ⑦ma 'dug go/ /dge slong ma rgan mo nad ma tsodes thos nas des chadage slong ma rnams dul smras pa/ gang tshun chad khyed cag bsod snyoms la dong ba de tshun chad nas sbed ma ma 'dug pa de ni bden te0/ 'di ltar 'phags pa 'char ka byon par gyur nas 'di de dang lhan cig 'greng zhing /ma bag mar 9blangs pa tshun chad 9kyang gcig gis gcig chal brjod do/ /7—249

dge slong ma de dag gis sbed ma la dris pa sbed ma khyod kyis de ltar ①byas pa bden nam/ phu nu mo dag bden no②/ /dge slong ma de dag ci'i phyir dge slong chadage slong ma dang lhan cig gcig pu cig ④dang dben pa skyabs ⑤yod pa na 'greng bar byed ces smod par byed phyar ka ⑥gtong bar byed kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la brjod pa dang / dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge slong ma dang lhan cig gcig pu cig ⑦dang dben pa skyabs yod pa na 'greng bar byed ces smod par byed/phyar ka gtong bar byed kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang gleng gzhi du'adi ⑨dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun ⑩bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med par ⑨mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang 8snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la rmas 8pa/ 'char ka khyod dge slong ma dang lhan cig gcig ④su cig tsodang dben pa skyabs yod pa na 'greng ba bden nam btsun pa mad ⑩do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi ༅tshul ma yin pa rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun 8pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du skyems rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de lta 0bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi 0bslab phyepa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste/ zhes bya ba la 7—250

sogs pa snga ma bzhin ①rna/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis ②'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge slong ma dang lhan cig gcig pu cig ⑧dang dben pa skyabs yod pa na 'greng ④na ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni 'char ku'am/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'ol/ /dge slong ma dang zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa dang ngo / /lhan cig ces bya ba ni de de ⑤dang lhan cig ༅go/ /gcig pu cig ⑦dang zhes bya ba de ⑤ni de de ⑨dang ngo / /dben pa zhes bya ba ⑩ni gang na ⑩skyes pa dang / bud med dang ma ning 6)gzhan 'ga' yang med pa'o/ /skyabs yod pa na 0zhes bya ba ni lngas bskyabs ④pa na ④ste/ rtsig ⑩pas bskyabs 0pa dang rib mas bskyabs 8pa dang yol yibs bskyabs rjo pa dang / thibs pos bskyabs ⑥pa dang / mtshan mos bskyabs ⑥pa tshuna'o/ /'greng na zhes bya ba ni 'dom gang gi ④nang du cha'agreng na'o / /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang yi dgas ngan song dang ngan 'gro dang chalog par ltung ba dag ⑦tu sreg phyopar byed/'tshod par byed ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ⑥ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/des na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ⑥ ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis ji tsam cung 0zad dge slong ma dang lhan cig gcig pu cig dudang dben pa skyabs yod pa na 'greng na thams cad du ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /sgo khang du du'agreng ba dang / sman bla'athag byatu 'jud 0pa dang sgo ma bcad par 'greng ⑥ba dang / gzhan dag ⑥'jug cing gzhan dag 'byung yin ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang /7—251
